name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Tip Tracker: Server Income is a tip tracker for servers and bartenders who want a clear record of each shift. Enter your tips, hours, base wage and tip-outs, then review the income you recorded and your effective hourly pay. The app interface is in English.

KEEP ONE RECORD FOR EACH SHIFT
Record cash tips and card tips separately so you can see how a shift's total was formed. Add the amount shared with coworkers as a tip-out, enter your working hours and include your base wage when it applies. These are your own entries: the app does not connect to a restaurant's point-of-sale system, employer payroll or bank account.

See the result for that shift without reconstructing it from a calendar note. The hourly figure uses the pay, tips, tip-outs and hours you entered. A missing or incorrect entry changes the result, so you can return to a record and correct the facts rather than treating the displayed amount as an employer-issued statement.

SEPARATE YOUR JOBS
Keep records for different jobs and label each shift with the job it belongs to. This is useful when you work at more than one restaurant, split your week between serving and bartending, or want to distinguish shifts with different base wages. Your own job names keep those records recognizable. The base wage belongs to the job, so changing it also updates that job's past shifts.

REVIEW DAYS, WEEKS AND MONTHS
Use the calendar and shift history to find a particular day. Weekly and monthly totals bring recorded earnings together, while hourly summaries help account for different amounts of time worked. Day-of-week comparisons show patterns in your own past entries. They do not predict what another shift will pay or promise that choosing a particular day will increase your income.

HANDLE THE DETAILS THAT CHANGE A TOTAL
Cash, card tips and shared tips play different roles in the calculation. Recording each amount makes it easier to check why two shifts with similar sales produced different take-home totals. If you enter sales, you can also review the tip percentage calculated from those figures. Sales are optional context, not an automatic connection to a register.

For late service, a shift added between midnight and 6 AM defaults to the previous day, and you can edit its date. Check the date when your schedule crosses midnight so the calendar reflects how you organize your work. Hours and amounts remain manually entered; the app is not a time clock that verifies attendance.

TAKE YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
Export a CSV when you want the recorded values and calculations in a spreadsheet. The CSV is an export for your own review; it is not a tax return, a payroll filing or a backup that the app can import. Check the dates and values you share before sending a file to someone else.

A separate JSON backup preserves supported app records and settings. Keep a copy in a location you control. Restoring a valid backup replaces the current local records, so check the file and keep a recent copy before restoring. Backup files are plain text and should be stored with care if they contain information you consider private.

YOUR OWN INCOME HISTORY
Core records are stored locally without creating an account. Exporting or sharing a file sends that chosen copy through the destination you select. Purchase processing and app updates are separate from the personal shift log; local record storage is not a promise that every service interaction stays on the device.

Use the app to organize recorded income and compare your own work history. Its figures depend on the details you supply and are not tax, legal or financial advice. Confirm wages, withholding, reporting duties and payroll differences with the relevant employer or qualified professional. A useful shift log gives you a clearer set of facts to review; it does not guarantee future earnings.

name: Tip Tracker - Server Tip Log
description:
Tip Tracker is a simple, offline tip tracker for people who work for tips. If you wait tables, tend bar, drive for delivery, or work any job where your pay changes every shift, it keeps your tips and hours in one place — right on your phone.

Tips are real income, and most of them never appear on a paycheck stub. Cash tips get counted once at the end of the night and then forgotten. Card tips land days later, already taxed. By the time you file, nobody remembers which shifts were good and which were terrible.

Tip Tracker turns that blur into a few taps.

No account. No cloud upload. No bank connection. Everything you log stays on your device.

WHY SERVERS AND BARTENDERS KEEP A TIP TRACKER

• OFFLINE BY DEFAULT — your tip log lives on your phone, not on a server. No sign-up, no email, no password to forget.
• FIX ANY MISTAKE — edit any past shift, any time. Nothing is locked once you save it.
• YOUR DATA IS YOURS — export your log to a file whenever you want, and bring it back on a new phone. No fee, ever.
• A SERVER TIP TRACKER, AND MORE — built for restaurant servers, bartenders, delivery drivers, baristas, and anyone else whose income arrives in small bills.
• ONE SHIFT, ONE ENTRY — log a shift in seconds: date, hours, tips. No forced fields, no five-screen wizard.
• CASH AND CARD, TOGETHER — one shift can hold both, so the total you see is what you actually walked out with.
• YOUR WEEK, YOUR WAY — set your week to start on the day your pay period actually starts.
• YOUR REAL HOURLY RATE — tips minus tip-out, divided by hours you actually worked. Not the number on the job posting.
• TIP-OUT, SORTED — record what you pay out to bussers and the bar, as a percentage or a flat amount, so the number you keep is the number you see.
• ONE CLEAN TIP LOG — export your shifts as CSV or a backup file you can hand to your tax preparer, instead of a shoebox of notes.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

1. Log a shift in seconds — no forms, no forced fields.
2. Fix a past shift any time — nothing is locked once you save it.
3. Keep cash tips and card tips apart on the same shift.
4. Deduct tip-out and tip pool amounts so the number you keep is the one you see.
5. Watch your day, week and month totals build up as one running tip log.
6. Learn your average hourly rate before you decide whether to pick up another shift.

WHAT TIP TRACKER IS NOT

It is not a bank app. It never asks for your bank login, your email, or your contacts. It does not need an internet connection to log a shift. It does not sell your data.

PRIVACY BY ARCHITECTURE

Most tracker apps want an account and a cloud sync before you can type your first shift. Tip Tracker takes the opposite approach: if the data never leaves your phone, it cannot leak from ours. That is not a feature we bolted on — it is how the app is built.

WHO IT IS FOR

• Restaurant servers keeping a daily tip log.
• Bartenders tracking cash tips, card tips and tip-outs.
• Delivery drivers who want their tips recorded alongside their shifts.
• Baristas, nail techs, stylists, and casino dealers — anyone paid in tips.
• Anyone who wants an honest tip log for tax season without a subscription maze.

A note on taxes: Tip Tracker is a record-keeping tool. It helps you keep a tip log and see your totals. It does not tell you what you owe, and it does not file anything for you. For questions about what you need to report, talk to a qualified tax professional.

Your next shift is in a few hours. Log it in one tap.

name: Tip+: Restaurant Tip Manager
description:
Tip+ is the most customizable tip calculator built for how real restaurants actually work.

Every restaurant splits tips differently. Some pool everything and divide by hours. Some tip out the bar 10%, the food runners 5%, and the busser a flat amount. Some pay servers on sales, not tips. DOWN TO EARTH, NOT OVERBUILT

Tip+ is made for the person who closes the restaurant at midnight, not for an accounting department. No jargon. No forced workflows. No "enterprise" features you'll never touch. Open the app, enter what happened tonight, split the tips, go home.

CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING

• Role weights — servers 1.0, bar 0.8, runners 0.5 — whatever your house rule is.
• Tip-outs — pull a percentage off the top for the kitchen, bar, or support before the pool is split.
• Overrides — bump someone up for a great night, adjust for a mid-shift role change, or exclude a no-show, all with a note attached.
• Templates — save the shift structures you run every week so setup takes seconds.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Dashboard — today's tips, active shifts, and recent settlements at a glance.

Staff & Groups — add employees, assign roles, and group them (servers, bar, kitchen, support). Bulk import from a spreadsheet if you're switching over.

Shifts — build shifts from templates or on the fly. Import daily sales sheets or tip totals so you're not retyping POS numbers.

Settlements — run a settlement for any shift. Tip+ shows the source tips, the formula, and the per-person breakdown. Nothing hidden.

Audit Logs — every edit, every settlement, every override is captured so nothing gets quietly changed after the fact.

Multi-location — run more than one restaurant from a single account and switch in one tap.

Languages — English and Simplified Chinese.

BUILT FOR THE MESSY REALITY

Split shifts, mid-shift role changes, a bartender who covered a section for an hour, a no-show, a comp that changes the tip pool — Tip+ handles the awkward stuff without breaking the audit trail. Because that's the actual job.

WHY TIP+

• Fair — every split is transparent and the math is visible.
• Fast — close a shift in minutes.
• Flexible — your rules, not ours.
• Trustworthy — full audit log so staff and owners both know the numbers weren't fudged.

PRIVACY

Your data stays yours. We don't sell employee or tip information.

See how you spend your time with daily, weekly or monthly reports and graphs. Look them in the app or export them to send that data to your clients (or to analyze it further with through business intelligence and see to where your hours are going).

◼ Calendar

◼ Pomodoro Mode
Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique, thanks to our built-in Pomodoro mode.

The idea behind the Pomodoro technique is that you can work more effectively when you work in timed, 25-minute increments (with breaks in between). Our Pomodoro timer automatically tracks your time in 25-minute increments, with notifications, a full screen mode, and countdown timer to really help you stay focused and on task.

◼ Favorites
Favorites allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used time entries. Start tracking time on a favorite time entry with one tap.

◼ Notifications
Enable notifications so that you always know if & what are you tracking (or if you're not tracking anything!), and always be aware where does your time go.

◼ Customize your time entries with projects, clients and tags
Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients and tags. Clearly see where your work hours go and adjust your precious time & routines accordingly.

◼ Shortcuts
By using @ and #, you can quickly add those projects and tags much faster and get back to work right away!

◼ Widgets
Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

◼ Sync
Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

◼ Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

◽ But what if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

◽ Can I send you some feedback?
You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. Whether you are at an office, in commute, stuck on a space mission to Mars or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money - track your time anywhere you go!

- Verified odometer (optional): connect a supported vehicle to check logged distance against the vehicle's own odometer data.
- Driving coach: after each trip, see harsh braking, hard acceleration, speeding and idling.
- EcoPoints: earn points for efficient driving and consistent trip logging.
- No plug-in devices or hardware to install.

Built for people who drive for work
Field service and trades technicians, sales and healthcare field staff, real estate agents, delivery and rideshare drivers, contractors and small business owners.

Bring your team
Coworkers drive for work too? Share Fuelshine with them. If your company wants everyone's mileage in one place, it can set up Fuelshine for Teams at getfuelshine.com.

How it works
1. Install Fuelshine and choose IRS, CRA or your company's rate.
2. Allow location so trips are detected automatically.
3. Drive as usual. Tag each trip Business or Personal.
4. At month-end, send your mileage reimbursement report. At tax time, export your mileage log.

Questions
Can I use Fuelshine for employer mileage reimbursement?
Yes. Export a report of your business trips with distance, dates and the amount at your chosen rate, and send it to whoever approves your mileage claims.

Is Fuelshine an IRS mileage tracker or a CRA mileage tracker?
Both. Choose IRS (miles) if you file in the United States or CRA (kilometres) if you file in Canada. It works as an IRS mileage tracker app and a CRA mileage tracker app on the same phone.

Will my employer see my personal trips?
No. Only trips you mark Business go into your report.

Do I need extra hardware?
No. Fuelshine runs on your phone.

Is it free?
Free to start. Fuelshine Pro unlocks unlimited trips, multiple vehicles and advanced reports.

Fuelshine helps you keep accurate records. It is not tax advice. Check with your accountant, employer or tax authority for your situation.

Website: www.getfuelshine.com

name: 1099 Quarterly Tax Estimator
description:
Freelance tax, without the spreadsheet.

For 1099 contractors and gig workers paid without tax taken out.

NOT A GOVERNMENT APP — 1099 Quarterly Tax Estimator is an independent app
from Firefly Software. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized
by the IRS, the U.S. government or any state tax agency, and it does not
represent them or file anything with them.

Log income. Know what to set aside. Never miss a deadline. Built on the
safe harbor rule: pay 100% of last year's tax across 4 payments (110% over
$150K AGI) and the IRS won't penalize you — we calculate that number in 60
seconds of setup.

FREE FOREVER — no trial, no card:
• Your quarterly set-aside number (safe harbor or projection)
• Every federal deadline with a countdown
• Three reminders per quarter: 2 weeks, 3 days, due day
• Your state's own deadlines when they differ from the federal ones
• A set-aside tracker against what the quarter needs
• A one-tap link to pay on IRS.gov
• Income log with CSV import from your invoicing app
• We tell you if you are under the $1,000 federal threshold
• Year overview with paid/upcoming status

PREMIUM — pay the least you legally can, and know what April holds:
• What to set aside from each payment — the real tax it causes, not a
flat rule. Past the Social Security cap the rate drops sharply
• What April looks like: safe harbor stops the penalty, not the bill. We
show it building on income you have already been paid
• Your household: a spouse's salary, withholding and a retirement
contribution each move what you owe by thousands
• Your state's tax folded into every quarterly figure
• The state rules that change what you owe: some split the year unevenly,
and the income at which they start asking varies
• Income by client — the fastest way to check that every 1099-NEC you
expected has arrived
• Retirement room: your SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) limits from your own
profit, and what each contribution takes off the bill. A solo 401(k)
usually allows far more than a SEP
• A year-end PDF for your accountant: income by client, every payment
with its confirmation number, estimated vs actual
• CSV export as a real file you can share
• A home screen widget with your number and the countdown

We add a state only after checking its rules against that state's own tax
agency. Every income-tax state except Connecticut is covered — 40 states plus
DC. If yours is not, the app says so and does not charge you for it. Some states do not ask
individuals for quarterly payments at all, and we say that instead of
showing you deadlines that do not exist.

WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM — OFFICIAL SOURCES
Every federal figure and date comes from these public IRS pages and is
rechecked every December. Deadlines follow the IRS rule for weekends and
holidays and are checked against every date the IRS has published since 2016.

Due dates, rate schedules and standard deductions — Form 1040-ES:
https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-1040-es

Who has to pay, and the $1,000 federal threshold:
https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/estimated-taxes

The 100% / 110% safe harbor rule this app is built on — Topic no. 306:
https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc306

The 2026 brackets and deductions — Rev. Proc. 2025-32:
https://www.irs.gov/irb/2025-45_IRB

State deadlines come from each state's own tax agency; the IRS directory:
https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/state-government-websites

Everything stays on your device — no account, no bank login, and none of
your tax data leaves your phone.

DISCLAIMER
This app does not represent the IRS, the U.S. Department of the Treasury or
any state tax authority, and it is not authorized to provide or facilitate
government services. It is not a filing tool: it estimates what to set aside
and reminds you when payment is due, while your accountant or filing
software handles the return. All figures are estimates for planning only and
are not tax advice.

description:
Travel Logs is an extremely easy and effective way to track your trips for all of your vehicles. It is the next generation vehicle mileage logbook. It is a FBT ATO compliant vehicle log book, great for tax reimbursement. Suitable for cars and trucks. With a streamlined information-entry user interface and, the added option of using GPS to auto-fill in location information – you don’t need the paper version any more!

Logging information for a trip has never been so easy thanks to the GPS auto-fill feature that will automatically fill in your location, with a press of a button, and calculates the distance traveled using the GPS of your device. This makes tracking your trips all the more simple, less time-consuming and less stressful!

Key Features
◦ ATO Compliant
◦ Multiple Vehicles.
◦ Bluetooth hands-free device support for automatic trip start and stop.
◦ Log trip details (odometer, date, purpose, type, location, vehicle).
◦ Exporting of log reports in CSV and PDF format.
◦ Automatic start and stop of trips for assigned places.
◦ Use of GPS to auto-fill in location information and calculate distance traveled for each trip.
◦ Route recording.
◦ Vehicle expense tracking.
◦ Vehicle maintenance tracking.

GPS – Location Auto-fill and Tracking
Travel Logs has the option to allow you to use the GPS feature in your device to determine your current and/or end location. This will give you the option to auto-fill in the location details for your logs and also estimate the distance traveled so you won’t have to fill in the end odometer values!

There is also an option to use realtime GPS tracking, which track your distance traveled accurately instead of just estimating.

Bluetooth Hands-Free Support
Assign bluetooth devices for each vehicle and have Travel Logs automatically start and stop your trips when you connect and disconnect from the hands-free device.

Places
A place can be your home, work or frequent client address. Travel Logs can automatically start and end trips when you depart or arrive at an assigned place.

Route Recording
When using realtime GPS tracking, you can record the route you took for that trip. When viewing past trips, the route will be plotted on the map so you can see where you went, down to each individual street you took.

Log Reports
The log reports are in Comma Separated Value (CSV) format, so you can import and open in any of your favourite spreadsheet applications. (Excel, Numbers, etc)

This app complies with the Australian Tax Office (ATO) logbook format. It will calculate the percentage of business use for each vehicle and total business distance in the exported log reports.

The log reports include total distance traveled, the starting and ending odometer values, date/time, purpose of trip, trip type, location from start to finish, driver name, vehicle and registration number.

Vehicle Expense Tracking
Track the expense and credits for each of your vehicles.

Vehicle Maintenance and Service Record Logging
Keep track of each of your vehicles maintenance and service records.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

Fuel Optimizer – Know exactly how much fuel to add or burn to stay within legal truck axle weight limits

Your activity log stays on your device. The app uses advertising and diagnostic services as described in the privacy policy. Reminders depend on notification permission and operating-system scheduling; always monitor your tachograph.

This app is a planning aid. It does not replace the legal tachograph record or determine whether your journey is in scope. Calculations depend on your entries. Reduced daily-rest eligibility, split daily rest, weekly-rest compensation and night-work limits are not fully modelled. The working-time average uses up to 17 recorded weeks; your employer's fixed reference period may differ. Check the official rules and your tachograph before driving.

name: Nursora: Nurse Shift Calendar
description:
A nurse shift calendar that fills in your month with one swipe, built for 12-hour days and nights. Pick a shift, swipe your finger across the days, and your month is filled in. Day 7A–7P, Night 7P–7A, On-call and Off are ready on first launch, and every start and end time can be changed. Nursora opens straight to your month, works without signal and needs no account.

SWIPE YOUR MONTH IN
Your nurse shift calendar fills in with a swipe across a big month grid. Choose a shift pen at the bottom, then tap or swipe across the days. Each day shows the shift color and a short letter. Add a second shift on the same day, a note for a day, or your own shift type with any hours: 8, 10, 12 or 16-hour shifts, overnight shifts that end the next morning and an unpaid meal break. History is unlimited.

REPEAT YOUR ROTATION
A shift rotation repeats your pattern for as long as you need it. Draw one cycle of one to eight weeks with the same shift pens, for example 3 on, 4 off, and the rotation calendar repeats it. Pick up an extra day or swap a night and only that day changes; the rest of the rotation stays in place.

AN ALARM BEFORE EVERY SHIFT
Shift alarms ring before every shift, even with the screen locked. Each shift type can ring up to two. Alarms use the phone's alarm clock, so they ring when the screen is locked and come back after a restart. Alarm check in Settings plays a test alarm and shows how to keep battery saving from silencing it.

YOUR PAYCHECK ESTIMATE
Your duty roster doubles as a paycheck: enter your base hourly rate and pay period (weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly or monthly). Nursora adds night and weekend differentials for the hours inside their windows, charge or preceptor pay, holiday pay, on-call and call-back hours, and overtime: over 40 hours a week, the 8/80 rule, daily overtime in California, or your own rule. Every line is shown: hours, rate and amount. This is a gross estimate. Estimate only: your hospital's payroll rules decide your actual pay.

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
Share month sends a clean picture of your work schedule to a partner or family chat. Add to phone calendar puts the month you are viewing into a calendar you choose on this phone, so your family sees your nights in their own calendar app. A Next shift widget on the home screen shows your next shift and how long until it starts. Stats count your hours, shifts, night shifts and days off each month.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL. NO ACCOUNT.
Your shift calendar, alarms and paycheck work offline; only ads need the internet. There is no sign-up and no server of ours. Nothing gets lost: undo anything, keep a backup file, and Android's own backup restores your calendar on a new phone.

NURSORA PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Pay once, yours to keep. Your shift calendar, rotation, alarms and current paycheck stay free.
- Keep family calendar updated: the next 12 months go to the phone calendar and update when you change a shift; .ics export for any calendar app.
- More jobs: a hospital job plus PRN, agency or travel shifts, each with its own pay profile and color.
- More rotations and ready patterns (Kelly, Pitman, DuPont, 4 on 4 off).
- Year view: hours and pay charts for 12 periods, differentials and overtime by month.
- Hours and pay log as PDF or CSV to compare with your pay slip.
- Larger widgets for your week, month and current pay period, and four more themes.
- No ads.
Not ready to buy? Watch a short video to try year charts, a widget or a theme for 60 minutes, or to make one more PDF log.

NOT AFFILIATED WITH ANY HOSPITAL OR EMPLOYER
Nursora is an independent nurse shift calendar and shift planner for nurses, CNAs, LPNs, travel and PRN nurses. Not affiliated with any hospital or employer.

PRIVACY
Shifts, hours, pay rates and notes stay on this phone and in your own Google backup. Shifts go into the phone calendar only when you ask. The free version shows ads and sends anonymous usage statistics that never include your calendar, hours or pay.

name: Nurse Charting Pro: Bedside RN
description:
🏥 Nurse charting for busy bedside RNs


Nurse Charting Pro is a psych and med-surg nurse charting app for RNs who need structured nursing documentation without starting from a blank page.

Chart room by room during your shift. Generate AI nursing notes from your charted data. Prepare SBAR handoff reports from the same shift information.

Built for nursing workflows across psych, med-surg, tele, ICU, step-down, wound care, float pool, home health, visiting care, VA, and bedside care.

📋 Chart your shift as you go


Start a shift, assign rooms, document patients, review completed charts, add free-form notes, and use shift summaries before handoff. Nurse Charting Pro helps keep patient charting organized from first round to end of shift.

🧠 Psych charting


Use structured psychiatric nursing charting categories:
- Environment
- Mental and emotional state
- Thought patterns and behavior
- Safety assessment
- Speech and interactions
- Function and daily living
- Medical monitoring

Document SI, HI, AVH, behavior, mood, group attendance, medication compliance, discharge status, CIWA, COWS, and safety details with guided fields.

🩺 Clinical and med-surg charting


Use built-in clinical charting tools for bedside nursing documentation:
- Head-to-toe assessment
- Vitals and pain scale
- IV lines and access sites
- Glasgow Coma Scale
- Morse Fall Scale
- Braden Scale
- Skin and wound assessment
- Safety checks
- Notes and patient education

✨ AI nursing notes


Complete structured assessment fields, then generate AI nursing notes from the data already charted. Review the nursing narrative, edit when needed, and copy it into your EHR, EMR, or CPRS workflow.

AI supports documentation. Clinical judgment stays with you.

🗣️ SBAR handoff reports


Create SBAR handoff reports based on actual charted data. Situation, Background, Assessment, and Recommendation are organized from your shift information to support clearer nurse handoff and shift report workflows.

🔗 Export and EHR workflows


Copy, share, export, or use C-CDA and EHR-ready options depending on your workflow. Nurse Charting Pro supports FHIR R4 / SMART on FHIR paths for compatible EHR environments when configured.

🔒 Offline and privacy-minded


Nurse Charting Pro is designed for mobile nursing workflows with on-device encryption and end-of-shift patient data deletion. Offline charting helps you keep working when connectivity is unreliable.

👩‍⚕️ Built for


- Psych RNs
- Med-surg RNs
- Wound care nurses
- Float pool and travel nurses
- Night shift nurses
- Home health and visiting nurses
- VA nurses using CPRS
- Nursing students learning structured documentation

Why nurses use NCP


- Faster nurse charting during busy shifts
- Structured nursing documentation by room and category
- AI nursing notes generated from charted data
- SBAR handoff reports built from shift information
- Braden Scale, Morse Fall Scale, vitals, wound, and head-to-toe assessment tools
- Offline-capable mobile charting
- EHR, EMR, CPRS, C-CDA, and FHIR-ready documentation workflows

Always review generated narratives for accuracy before using them in official medical records. Nurse Charting Pro is a documentation aid and does not replace clinical judgment, facility policy, or EHR requirements.

Shift work often means variable earnings.

Build a clearer picture of your income and stay on top of your finances throughout the month.

Perfect for anyone who wants to:
-Track shift pay
-Monitor overtime
-Estimate earnings

-Budget their earnings

PLAN LIFE AROUND WORK
Shift work doesn't just affect your job. It affects family life, social plans, appointments, vacations and personal commitments.

MyShiftPlanner helps you see your availability at a glance, making it easier to plan ahead, organize events and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Whether you're arranging childcare, booking a vacation or coordinating plans with family and friends, you'll always know when you're available.

MANAGE VACATION TIME AND TIME OFF
Keep track of vacation time, sick leave and other absences alongside your shifts.

Viewing leave and work together helps reduce scheduling conflicts and makes it easier to plan your time throughout the year.

POWERFUL FEATURES
-Easy-to-use shift calendar
-Multiple shift patterns
-Custom shift types
-Earnings and pay tracking
-Overtime calculations
-Vacation time tracking
-Notes and reminders
-Shift alarms and notifications
-Home screen widgets
-Calendar integration
-Cloud backup and synchronization
-Reports and summaries
-Multiple schedules
-Custom colors
-Flexible scheduling tools

PRO PACK
Unlock advanced tools designed to help you get even more from MyShiftPlanner.

Pro Pack includes pay tracking, advanced reporting, additional customization options, device calendar sync, and sharing. Premium features designed for busy shift workers.

ABOUT MYSHIFTPLANNER
MyShiftPlanner was created with one simple goal: making shift work easier to manage.

We're a small independent team dedicated to supporting shift workers through better technology. Every feature we build is designed to help people stay organized, reduce stress and feel more in control of their working lives.

We understand the challenges of shift work because we speak to shift workers every day. Your feedback helps shape the future of the app, and many of our most popular features have come directly from user suggestions.

Need help? We're here for you.

If you have a question, need support or have an idea for a future feature, get in touch. Every support request is answered by a real person who genuinely wants to help.

Thank you for choosing MyShiftPlanner.

Together, we're making shift work easier to manage.

name: Overtime Calculator
description:
This simple application will make it easy to find out how much time a person works beyond the regular working hours. The operation of this application is as follows.

✔ If an employee arrives at work before the company's start time and works beyond the company's finish time, the application will not take into account the time he or she arrived before the company's start time for calculating overtime.

✔ If an employee arrives at work late and works after the company's finish time, the application will calculate overtime by subtracting the amount of time he or she was late.

✔ The total workhour is calculated by subtracting the launch time from the total work hour.

• Manage class schedules and non-instructional days
• Plan lessons, class sessions, and instructional units

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

name: Chalkbook: Teacher Gradebook
description:
Chalkbook is a teacher gradebook and class notebook that fits in your pocket. Built for teachers who would rather spend their time teaching than typing scores into a spreadsheet at 11pm.

YOUR WHOLE CLASS IN ONE PLACE
Set up a class in under a minute, add your students, and you are ready for Monday. Grades, attendance, homework checks and daily notes all live together — no more juggling a paper attendance register, a spreadsheet and a stack of sticky notes.

A CLASS JOURNAL YOU CAN ACTUALLY KEEP UP WITH
Open a class and you land straight in the journal. Mark who is present, late or absent. Record who knew the lesson and who did not. Jot a quick note while it is still fresh. Taking attendance and recording grades takes seconds, and it happens while you are still standing at the front of the room.

SEND GRADE REPORTS TO PARENTS WITH ONE LINK
Parents do not need to download anything. Send them a single link and they can look up their own child's grades in any browser. No accounts for them to forget, no app to install, no phone calls asking how their child is doing. The link shows grades only — your private notes never appear on it.

EXPORT GRADES WITHOUT RETYPING
End of term should not cost you a weekend. Export your gradebook straight to Excel and fill in your school's template automatically. Generate a PDF grade report or a printable class roster. The numbers you already entered are the numbers that come out.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
School wifi always drops out at the worst moment. Chalkbook is an offline gradebook: everything is stored on your device first, so it opens instantly and works the same in a basement classroom as it does at your desk. Sync when you are ready.

WHAT TEACHERS USE CHALKBOOK FOR
- Taking daily attendance and tracking absences
- Recording grades, marks and homework checks
- Keeping a class journal with notes on each student
- Keeping a class roster and student records
- Sharing grade reports with parents
- Exporting a gradebook to Excel at the end of term
- Using one tool instead of three at the front of the room

FREE
- One class with unlimited students
- Full class journal: attendance, homework and notes
- Grades and basic statistics
- Parent grade lookup link
- Printable class list

PRO
- Unlimited classes
- Export to Excel and PDF grade reports
- Advanced statistics per student and per class
- Cloud backup and restore, so a lost phone is not a lost year
- Move students between classes

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Vietnamese, German, French, Japanese and Korean.

A NOTE ON BACKUP
On the free plan your data lives only on this device. If you lose your phone or reinstall the app, it is gone. Pro includes cloud backup — please turn it on, or export regularly. One exception: private notes are never backed up, so they do not travel to a new phone.

Built by a small team who listened to teachers. If something is missing or in your way, write to us — we read every message and we ship fixes fast.

- Keep a daily teaching diary in one tidy place

- Teacher Diary: Record your daily class activities, periods, topics, attendance, and notes. Build a complete day-to-day log of your teaching work that you can revisit anytime.

- Service Record: Store your appointment letters, transfer orders, postings, and complete government service history in one place. Find any old document in seconds.

description:

Behavior Tracker ABC is a simple behavior logger for parents and carers who want to record difficult moments, understand patterns over time, and create clearer notes to share with others.

Quickly record what happened before, during and after an incident using an ABC-style format:

• Antecedent: what was happening just before?
• Behavior: what did you see?
• Consequence: what happened next?
• Severity and duration
• Location
• Early signs
• What helped
• Notes

Behavior Tracker can be used by families supporting children who experience meltdowns, self-injurious behavior, distress, difficulties with transitions or denied access, sensory triggers, or other challenging moments.

Reports & Insights

A one-time purchase unlocks Reports & Insights. There is no subscription.

Explore patterns across your recorded incidents, including:

• Entries over time
• Average severity
• Average duration
• Common antecedents, behaviors and responses
• Situations that often lead to incidents
• Changes and trends over time
• Behavior Calendar showing how incidents are distributed across the month

The Behavior Calendar provides a simple visual heatmap so you can quickly see quieter and busier days and identify patterns that might otherwise be difficult to notice.

You can also generate shareable PDF reports from your logged incidents. Reports can include incident summaries, charts, antecedent-behavior summaries, common situation summaries, average severity, average duration, and recorded patterns over time.

Reports may be useful when preparing for conversations with family members, schools, carers, therapists, consultants, or behavior specialists. They are based only on the incidents you record and do not provide clinical conclusions or advice.

Common situations

Add common situations such as morning dressing, waiting for dinner, bedtime, or leaving the house, and estimate how often they usually happen.

This helps put incident counts into context. For example, 3 incidents in a week may mean something very different if the situation occurred 3 times compared with 30 times.

Export and share

Export your behavior logs or create PDF reports to help prepare for conversations with family members, schools, carers, therapists, consultants, or behavior specialists.

Behavior Tracker ABC is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis or treatment advice. It is a practical logging and reflection tool designed to help families record what happened and notice patterns over time.

WHY PARENTS USE KIDS TIMER

Create quick timers for short tasks or longer routines.

Build multi-step routines with back-to-back countdowns, such as brush teeth, pajamas, story time, and lights out.

A clear end signal helps children know when the countdown is finished.

Keep the timer simple and child-friendly while parents stay in control.

GREAT FOR DAILY ROUTINES

Kids Timer can be used as a:

• Kids timer
• Toddler timer
• Visual timer
• Countdown timer
• Sandglass timer
• Hourglass timer
• Routine timer
• Chore timer
• Bedtime timer
• Screen time timer
• Classroom timer
• Homework timer
• Study timer
• Focus timer

HELP CHILDREN UNDERSTAND TIME

Time is abstract. A visual countdown makes it easier for kids to understand waiting, transitions, and “time is almost up.” This can be especially helpful for children who respond better to visual routines, predictable schedules, and clear transitions.

Use Kids Timer Visual Countdown to support calmer mornings, smoother bedtime, easier screen time endings, better focus, and more independent routines.

Download Kids Timer Visual Countdown and make time easier for kids to see, follow, and understand.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

name: Shoot Planner: Photo Shot List
description:
Plan the shoot before the shoot. Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner and shot list app for photographers and filmmakers — and every part of it works offline.

Most tools do one thing: a moodboard, or a shot list, or a sun calculator. Shoot Planner chains them into one pipeline — references to shots to locations to lighting to storyboard to gear — then follows you into the field on the day.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The golden hour engine and the field mode are fully on-device. No signal on a canyon rim, in a basement venue, or on a plane means nothing to this app. Your shoot day does not depend on a login screen loading.

SHOT LIST
Build a shot list with priorities, descriptions, focal length and camera notes. Assign shots to a day, drag to reorder, and mark each one captured as you go.

REFERENCES AND MOODBOARD
Collect a visual moodboard per project — shoot with the camera, pull from your photo library, or paste a Pinterest, Instagram or web link and the image and title are fetched for you. Browse it as a masonry gallery and filter by tag.

REFERENCE TO SHOT, IN ONE TAP
Turn any reference into a shot, permanently linked. On set you see the inspiration image beside the shot you are taking — not buried in a different app on a different tab.

GOLDEN HOUR AND BLUE HOUR
An offline solar engine gives sunrise, sunset, the golden hour window with its exact duration, blue hour, and the sun path for every day and location in your plan. No network, no subscription wall, no waiting for a map tile.

LOCATION SCOUTING AND MAP
Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. It runs entirely offline and syncs when you are back in service.

TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

PRICING
Free to use, with a capped number of projects. Pro unlocks unlimited projects at $6.99/month or $59.99/year — around 28% off annually — and starts with a 7-day free trial.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

Download Shoot Planner and walk onto your next shoot knowing exactly what you came for.

name: PlanIt Earth: VR Photo Planner
description:
For landscape, travel, nature, city, night, time-lapse, star-trail, Milky Way and astro photographers: PlanIt Earth builds on everything we learned from PlanIt Pro and takes previsualization to a new level.

Ansel Adams called it previsualization: imagining the final print before the shot is taken. Seeing a scene before you travel greatly raises the odds of coming home with the photo you wanted. PlanIt Earth is built around that one idea: see the shot before you go.

What sets it apart is the photorealistic VR viewfinder. Instead of reading numbers on a map, you stand at your camera position and see the real terrain, built from satellite imagery and elevation data, with the Sun, Moon, Milky Way, stars, clouds, 3D markers and your framing where they will be. Scrub time and watch light and shadows move through your composition.

There isn't always a signal in the field. Preload offline elevation, maps and markers and keep scouting and planning offline.

Plan the light. Preview the scene. Arrive ready.

**FEATURES**

**Photorealistic VR planning**
- Real terrain and horizon rendered from elevation data and satellite imagery
- Photoreal city backgrounds with Google 3D Tiles, plus Street View and your own photos
- Aim with camera and scene pins; focal length, angle of view and line of sight
- Live depth-of-field and bokeh preview: see the blur, not numbers
- Aerial and drone view, immersive full screen, and an AR viewfinder for framing on site

**Sun, Moon, Milky Way and sky**
- Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, golden hour, blue hour, twilight and astronomical darkness
- Sun and Moon direction, altitude, paths and alignment timing
- Milky Way Center direction, visibility and realistic sky placement, with Milky Way Seeker for the best dates and locations
- Stars, planets, constellations, meteor showers, comets, eclipses, rainbows and moonbows
- The Sun drawn from a time-matched NASA SDO image at its true apparent size

**Alignment and shoot planning**
- Find where and when the Sun or Moon lines up with your subject
- Search the sky across years for the conditions you want
- Plan sequences, multi-day shoots and time-lapses on a key-frame timeline
- Exposure guides for eclipses, star trails, the Milky Way and more
- Smart auto shooting fires your camera at the planned moment
- Measure distance, height, elevation and two-station geometry

**Map-based scouting**
- Full-screen planning map with camera and scene pins and direction lines
- Multiple map providers and layers, terrain, light-pollution and aurora overlays
- Search locations, save markers and 3D models, record and import tracks
- Offline regions: map, elevation and markers downloaded for the field

**Weather and field conditions**
- Photographer-focused weather and forecast cards
- Cloud, visibility, fog, wind, humidity, frost, dust and other shooting conditions
- Aurora forecasts, solar activity, space-weather alerts, tides and waves
- ISS and satellite passes, aircraft transits and rocket launches, with a transit alarm

**Telescope rig control**
- Drive an equatorial mount, focuser and astronomy camera from the phone over Wi-Fi or USB, or through the SharpCap bridge on a PC
- Still being finished: many models are untested against real hardware, so check with your own gear

**Plans, markers and tracks**
- Save complete plans with map position, pins, time and shooting setup, grouped into folders by trip, subject or place
- Sign in with your PlanIt account to sync plans, markers, tracks and settings across devices

**PlanIt+**
PlanIt Earth is free to explore. PlanIt+ unlocks the photorealistic VR viewfinder, the night, time-lapse, alignment, aerospace and weather modules, and offline regions, as an auto-renewable annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Coming from PlanIt Pro? Your past purchases become credit toward PlanIt+.

name: Shot Designer
description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

name: Shot List Director
description:
Shot List Director es la lista de planos de tu rodaje en el móvil: escenas, planos, storyboard, ópticas y el orden de cada jornada, todo en un mismo sitio y sin conexión.

PLANOS CON TODOS SUS DATOS
• Divide el guion en escenas (número, INT/EXT, localización y momento del día).
• Cada plano recibe su código automático (1A, 1B, 2A…) y guarda tamaño (GPG, PG, PM, PP, PD…), ángulo, movimiento, soporte, focal, sujeto, acción, duración, tomas, tiempo de preparación, sonido, VFX y prioridad.
• Marca los planos como rodados o descartados y apunta la toma buena.

STORYBOARD CON TUS IMÁGENES
• Añade dibujos, fotos de referencia o capturas desde la galería del teléfono.
• Enlaza cada viñeta con su plano: aparece en la ficha del plano y en el PDF.
• Las viñetas se muestran con el formato del proyecto (16:9, 2.39:1, 9:16…).

HOJA DE CÁMARA
• Qué focales necesita el rodaje, cuántos planos usa cada una y cuáles están pendientes.
• Aviso cuando un plano pide una focal que no está en tu juego de ópticas.
• Soportes y movimientos con sus planos, y notas de óptica y de movimiento editables plano a plano.

ORDEN DE RODAJE POR JORNADAS
• Crea jornadas con fecha, citación, tiempo hasta el primer plano y pausa para comer.
• Ordena los planos del día: la app calcula la hora estimada de cada uno y la hora de fin.
• Agrupa los planos por montaje de cámara (soporte y óptica) para cambiar menos el equipo.
• Aviso de jornada larga y de planos que todavía no tienen día.
• La pestaña Rodaje reúne las jornadas de hoy y las próximas de todos tus proyectos.

EXPORTA Y COMPARTE
• Lista de planos en PDF (con miniaturas del storyboard si quieres), CSV para hojas de cálculo o texto para un chat.
• Exporta todo el proyecto, solo los pendientes o el orden de una jornada con sus horas.
• Tú eliges con qué app compartir el archivo o en qué carpeta guardarlo.

ORGANIZA VARIOS PROYECTOS
• Proyectos independientes con cliente, dirección, dirección de fotografía, fechas, formato y cadencia.
• Seis plantillas incluidas (spot de 30 segundos, entrevista documental, videoclip, escena de diálogo, vídeo corporativo y cobertura de evento) y tus propias plantillas.
• Duplica proyectos y planos, busca por texto, fecha y etiquetas.
• Progreso, historial de cambios y un resumen calculado solo con tus datos: duración en pantalla, tiempo estimado en set, planos sin jornada o sin viñeta.

PRIVACIDAD
• Sin cuenta, sin registro, sin anuncios, sin compras y sin suscripciones.
• Sin acceso a internet: tus proyectos e imágenes se guardan solo en tu teléfono.
• Copia de seguridad en un archivo JSON que guardas tú.
• Sin notificaciones: los avisos se ven dentro de la app.

Incluye un proyecto de ejemplo para probarla en un minuto y quitarlo después con un toque.

name: HybridForms: Mobile Forms
description:
Maps, photos, videos and biometric signatures right inside the form – offline, fully auditable, with AI under your own control.

HybridForms digitizes form-based processes in the field and in critical operating environments: capture on site, multi-stage workflow, legally binding sign-off, handover to your systems of record – for government, public safety, critical infrastructure and regulated industries.

Try it right away
Three sample forms from customer service, healthcare and sales can be tried without signing up, in English and German: fill in fields, take photos, sketch, record voice memos, sign. The sample forms have a reduced feature set.

Where HybridForms is used
Typical uses: asset inspection and substation rounds in grid operations, maintenance and test reports in servicing, route inspection reports in road infrastructure, safety walks and occupational safety in plants, defect documentation and construction handover on site, incident reporting and online crime reports for police and public agencies, audit checklists and quality assurance in manufacturing, consent forms and patient intake in clinics. Any form-based process can be modeled.

Document on site
Photos with annotations and WGS 84 coordinates, video capture with optional location and map excerpt, plus freehand sketches, voice memos, scans and barcode, QR and NFC capture.

Sign with legal validity
Handwritten signatures are captured as biometric characteristics – pressure profile, speed, writing direction and angle – and encrypted on the device itself (AES-256/RSA, eIDAS 910/2014, ISO/IEC 19794-7). The case is closed on site, with legal validity.

Maps and GIS inside the form
Maps from professional providers, your own map servers and existing GIS systems can be placed anywhere in a form as a form control. Your own geodata and thematic layers sit on top and can be toggled individually; tapping an object shows the related information. Without a connection, the stored map image stays available.

AI under your own control
The AI features require a Trusted.AI edition of the HybridForms Server. Your administrators choose the AI model and the context it works in; it runs on your own infrastructure or as a dedicated service within the European legal area - no external AI services, no training on your process data. Use is assistive: people make the decisions.

Works without a network
Forms, catalogs and master data are available without a connection; captured data syncs as soon as the network is back.

Security and compliance
All data stays with the customer: encrypted transmission, GDPR-compliant retention periods, on-premises or European hosting. The audit trail records every change to a form automatically, with timestamp and user. Independently security-tested, with ongoing review against the BSI security checklist. Aligned with NIS2, BSI IT-Grundschutz, eIDAS and the EU AI Act.

From the field to sign-off
Multi-stage processes with stages, group and auto checkout, rejection, automatic PDF and email output in your corporate design. Self-service for citizens, customers and patients: as a kiosk view on the device with PIN release, or as an anonymous web form without sign-in, for example an online crime reporting portal.

Connects to your existing systems
Bidirectional data API, XML/XSLT, HL7, CSV, SQL export; connects to SAP, ERP, CRM, GIS/ESRI and line-of-business systems. User management via Active Directory, ADFS and OpenID Connect.

For production use
HybridForms is an enterprise and government solution for critical infrastructure and highly regulated environments. Production use requires a HybridForms Server and an account from your organization; the sample forms do not.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. "What should I practice today?" "Which pieces have I neglected?" Get personal suggestions based on your practice history. Plan a session around the time you have, revisit overlooked pieces and find practical ways to work on your music.

Use the metronome while you practice, then record your playing and listen back. Revisit earlier recordings to hear changes that can be hard to notice from one day to the next.

• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards

Choose a workout plan based on your goals and fitness level. Whether you're focused on weight loss, building muscle, strength training, or staying fit, your workout planner helps you follow a structured routine at home.

Train your abs, chest, arms, core, glutes, and legs with targeted exercises, or choose full-body workouts for a balanced routine. Mix and match workout routines based on the areas you want to focus on.
💪 Suitable for All Fitness Levels
Whether you're new to exercise or already train regularly, you can find workouts suited to your current fitness level. Start with beginner-friendly exercises and progress to more challenging training when you're ready.
🏠 Home Workouts with No Equipment
Exercise at home using your own body weight—no gym required. Try bodyweight workouts and bodyweight training designed for strength, mobility, and everyday fitness.
🎓 Expert-Designed Training
Combine cardio, strength training, recovery exercises, warm-ups, and stretching in one fitness app. Coach-designed sessions help you build a more balanced workout routine.
🧩 Fun & Diverse Workouts
Keep training fresh with strength workouts, weight-loss workouts, HIIT, calisthenics, push-up challenges, ab workouts, full-body routines, warm-ups, stretching, and more.
📊 Smart Progress Tracker
Automatically track your workouts and progress so you can see how your fitness routine develops over time.
⏰ Daily Reminders
Stay consistent with daily reminders that make it easier to fit exercise into your schedule.
🔝 Detailed Video Instructions
Follow clear workout videos and professional guidance to learn proper form, understand each exercise, and train with greater confidence.

Build Muscle & Strength Training
Want to build muscle at home and improve your strength? Follow structured strength training and muscle-building workouts using bodyweight exercises and progressive routines designed for different fitness levels.

Train your chest, arms, legs, core, and full body with strength-focused workouts. You can also add calisthenics and bodyweight training to build a strong foundation without gym equipment.

Weight Loss & Fat Burning Workouts
If your goal is to lose weight, choose from cardio, HIIT, full-body workouts, and fat-burning exercise routines you can do at home. These workouts help you stay active and burn calories as part of a balanced fitness routine.

Convenient Home Workout App
Work out whenever it fits your day. Home Workout App: Fitness offers a wide range of free home workouts that require no equipment, making it easy to train using only your body weight.

Whether you have a few minutes for a quick exercise session or want to follow a complete home workout routine, you can choose training that works for your goals and lifestyle.

Diverse Workouts and Exercises
Explore strength training, bodyweight workouts, calisthenics, ab workouts, weight-loss routines, and full-body exercise. Try movements such as burpees, push-ups, planks, mountain climbers, squats, sit-ups, and more.

Professional Fitness Coaches
Personalized plans and workouts are designed by professional fitness coaches. Follow expert-guided videos to understand each movement, improve your form, and build a workout routine you can stick with.

name: Baby Tracker - Newborn Log
description:
Baby Tracker brings a baby feeding tracker, sleep tracker and diaper log together in one easy-to-use newborn diary. Record breastfeeding, bottles, pumping, growth, health and milestones, and share your baby’s daily routine with caregivers.

Designed by busy parents, for busy parents, it keeps everyday tracking quick and clear—from late-night nursing to the first steps.

WHAT’S NEXT

One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.

What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:

• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper

Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.

What’s Next is optional. All core tracking features remain free.

GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE

Use What’s Next alongside your baby’s own cues and your judgment—not as a fixed schedule or instruction.

What’s Next is not medical advice. Contact a healthcare professional if you have concerns about your baby’s health, sleep or feeding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

What’s Next cues are created directly on your device. Your baby’s logs aren’t sent to us to generate them.

BABY FEEDING & BREASTFEEDING TRACKER

• Use the breastfeeding timer to track nursing on each breast
• Quickly see which side you last used
• Keep a bottle feeding log for formula and expressed breast milk
• Record solid foods and notes about preferences or reactions
• Review feeding times and your baby’s changing routine

PUMPING & BREAST MILK TRACKER

• Record pumping sessions and milk amounts
• Keep a breast pump log alongside your feeding records

BABY SLEEP TRACKER & NAP LOG

• Record daytime naps and nighttime sleep
• Use the sleep timer to keep a baby sleep log
• Review sleep patterns as your baby’s sleep schedule changes
• Set reminders and alarms
• See personalized What’s Next sleep and wake-up cues

DIAPER TRACKER

• Log wet, dirty and mixed diapers
• Quickly see when the last diaper change occurred
• Keep a diaper log with a clear history of changes

BABY GROWTH TRACKER

• Track weight, height and head circumference
• Follow infant growth charts based on World Health Organization standards

HEALTH & DEVELOPMENT

• Record medications, vaccinations and temperature
• Keep baby health records and notes together
• Use the baby milestone tracker to save first smiles, words and steps
• Add photos and notes to your baby journal

CHARTS & REPORTS

• Review daily, weekly and monthly activity charts
• Recognize patterns across sleep, feeding and diaper records
• Share useful information with caregivers and healthcare professionals

SYNC & SHARING

• Sync baby records across multiple devices
• Keep parents, family members and other caregivers up to date
• Track the same baby together without maintaining separate logs

BABY TRACKER PLUS

Baby Tracker Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription that includes ad-free tracking and personalized What’s Next sleep, feed and diaper cues.

Pricing, billing periods and renewal terms are shown in the app before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription through Google Play.

All core tracking remains free without Plus. Existing purchases, including the one-time Remove Ads purchase, continue to work as before.

Spend less time managing records and more time with your baby.

PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
• Everything in Plus, and
• Berry: 24/7 guidance with our expert-vetted AI chat
• Custom Sleep Plans: expert-designed sleep training plans, with regular check-ins as your baby grows

GENTLE, EVIDENCE-BASED APPROACH
Our sleep guidance never requires "crying it out." We blend trusted sleep science with gentle, family-centered solutions that respect your parenting style and fit your baby's unique wake windows, growth, and sleep regressions.

AWARD-WINNING RESULTS
Huckleberry ranks as one of the top parenting apps globally. We help families across 179 countries achieve better sleep. Up to 93% of families using our baby sleep solutions report improvement.

Whether you're expecting, tracking your baby's developmental milestones, navigating a sleep regression, starting solids, or raising a toddler, Huckleberry gives your family the tools and guidance to flourish at every stage.

description:
