Baby daybook: breastfeeding and bottle feeding, sleep schedule, diaper log, weight and height

The first months with your baby are a special time when every day matters for your infant's development. Parents want to understand how their baby eats, how much sleep they get, whether diapers are changed regularly, and if growth is on track. Our baby daybook helps make parenting simple, organized, and calm - from the first days of breastfeeding to establishing feeding and sleep routines.

"My Baby Tracker" is created for parents who want to easily track their baby's feeding, monitor sleep patterns, log diaper changes, and follow their infant's development.

What's inside the app:

Main screen with latest baby data
Convenient dashboard shows all important information about your baby in one place: when was the last breastfeeding or bottle feeding, how much time has passed since last sleep, when the diaper was changed, current infant weight and height. All information at your fingertips - you instantly see your baby's status.

Feeding tracker
Record every feeding: breastfeeding, bottle feeding, or formula. Mark start time and duration, which breast, amount of formula. Feeding timer helps you remember when baby ate last. Statistics show nursing frequency and help establish a feeding routine.

Sleep diary
Log every baby sleep: when fell asleep, how long slept, sleep quality. Sleep tracker shows total daily sleep time and helps build a routine. You'll see if your infant gets enough rest and how sleep patterns change over time.

Diaper tracking
Mark diaper changes and their contents. This is important for monitoring baby health: the number of wet and dirty diapers shows whether the infant is getting enough nutrition and how digestion is working.

Growth and weight
Record measurements of height, weight, head circumference. Growth charts show dynamics and help track how your baby is growing. Compare indicators with norms and share data with your pediatrician.

Growth and weight standards
Built-in standards help understand if baby weight and height correspond to age norms. You see how your infant develops compared to standard indicators for breastfed or formula-fed babies.

Sleep norms by age
Compare your baby's sleep patterns with recommended norms for their age. The app shows how much an infant should sleep at different months and helps understand if your baby is getting enough rest.

Development calendar
Track important milestones in baby development: when started holding head, rolling over, sitting, crawling. Development calendar suggests what skills appear at each age and helps not miss important moments.

Teething order
Mark the appearance of baby's first teeth and track teething order. Teething calendar shows typical sequence and timing of infant tooth appearance, helps prepare for this period.

Statistics and charts
All records about feeding, sleep, diapers are collected into visual charts. You see baby's daily routine, nursing frequency, total sleep time and can notice changes in development. This helps better understand infant needs.

Notes and reminders
Add notes about baby's wellbeing, mood, feeding or sleep specifics. Set reminders for next feeding or sleep time so you don't miss important moments.

"My Baby Tracker" - your reliable parenting assistant. Everything you need to track feeding, sleep, diapers, and development - in one place.

name: Baby: Breastfeeding Tracker
description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Email us your comments and suggestions, and we'll implement them as soon as possible!

name: Breastfeeding - Baby Tracker
description:
By a mom for other moms: Track all your baby's activities.
No ads, adaptable styles, status bar widgets and a night mode make tracking a breeze.
Track breastfeeding, complementary feeding, sleeps, crying, weight, height and head circumference, pumping times, temperature and even arbitrary self-defined events like nappies or fever.

No ads!
Diary and graphs to gain insights on how your baby develops over time.
Widgets for the lock screen, status bar and desktop are included for maximum convenience!
Nightmode with a configurable dark screen setup - you don't want to disturb anybody during nightly baby nursing.

Breastfeeding tracker (free part of the baby tracker)
- Record when and on which side the baby is nursed. Simple and intuitive.
- Subsequent baby feedings can be joined into one meal.
- Graphical analysis of the logged daily breastfeeding times and meals.
- Displays your typical breastfeeding times: When does your baby typically get hungry?
- The app supports multiple time frames for analysing the logged events: today, 24 hours, 3 days, 1 week, 1 month, all.
- Diary view gives you an overview of all logged events. You can always drill down to single events.
- Export the graph to png-images
- Widgets including start, pause and stop buttons (two sizes, small and big). Therefore no need to even open the app to log a baby nursing!
- No ads! This app will always be free of ads. We don't want you to get annoyed by stupid advertisements popping open, just because you've hit the wrong button while holding your hungry baby.


While the free application started with the focus of being a logger for breastfeeding, over time you might want to use it as a real baby tracker to log all kind of different events:


Pumping tracker (add-on)
- If you express milk you can also record and analyze pumping (time and quantity).
- Add comments to each record.
- Widget including start and stop buttons.
- The analysis graphs and diary keep a log of the pumping just like for any other baby nursing event.



Feeding tracker (add-on)
- Record and analyze complementary food or baby bottles.
- Breast feedings and complementary food can be joined into one meal.
- Minimized typing by self-learning and expandable food database.
- The analytic graphs and diary keep a log of the feedings just like for any other baby nursing event.
- You can add comments to each meal. That way you can document e.g. nursing positions.
- Widget including feeding button.


Sleeping tracker (add-on)
- Record when your baby is sleeping or crying.
- Widget "Sleeping" including start, pause, and stop buttons (two sizes, small and big)
- The analytic graphs and diary keep a log of naps and wails just like for any other baby nursing event.


Events tracker (add-on)
- Record predefined events (bath, temperature, diapers,....)
- You can also define and track your own events
- You can add reminders to each event
- Widget "Events" (resizeable)
- Events are also integrated into the diary and graphs - like the standard baby nursing .


Measurement tracker (add-on)
- Record weight, length/height and head circumference of your baby
- Graphical analysis of weight, length/height and head circumference with percentile charts (WHO Standards)


Temperature tracker (add-on)
- Record temperature of your baby
- Graphical analysis of temperature


Profiles (add-on)
- Allows you to add and track the nursing of several children e.g. for twins or to compare your baby to its older sibling.


In case of problems please write me a mail, I'm happy to help!The app should support you for every need of your baby - not just a breastfeeding tracker but a baby tracker.

name: Nevami Sleep – Baby Sleep Log
description:
Nevami Sleep is a simple sleep log for parents of babies aged 0 to 24 months. It is built to be used at 3 a.m., with one hand, half asleep.

ONE-TAP LOGGING
The main screen has a single large button: Asleep / Awake. Tap it and a timer starts. Tap again and the record is saved. No menus, no forms, nothing to think about.

ADD IT LATER
Forgot to log a nap? It happens. Pick a start and end time and add the sleep afterwards. You can edit or delete any record, and deletion can be undone.

NIGHT WAKINGS AND NOTES
Mark each night waking separately. Add a short note or tag when it helps: teething, illness, travel, a new place. Over time you will see what tends to go with what.

GROWTH TRACKING (WHO)
Enter weight, length and head circumference to see percentiles and z-scores based on the WHO Child Growth Standards, with your baby's line on the curves. Weight-for-length, BMI and the WHO growth velocity standards are included too. For premature babies, calculations use corrected age until 24 months. Everything is calculated on your device.

FEEDING AND DIAPERS
Log breastfeeding (left/right, duration), bottles (ml, breast milk or formula), solids and diapers (wet/dirty); see the day at a glance and how long since the last feed. For dirty diapers you can pick the stool color; for colors worth showing a doctor, you see a calm note.

SLEEP SOUNDS
White, pink and brown noise, shush, heartbeat, womb and rain are free. When the timer ends the sound fades out slowly; it keeps playing with the screen locked and needs no internet.

VACCINE SCHEDULE
For babies living in Türkiye, vaccine dates are counted from the birth date using the national schedule. Tick what has been given and get a reminder 3 days before the next visit. Your ticks stay on your device.

DEVELOPMENT PHASES AND COMMON QUESTIONS
Common phases such as the months when sleep structure changes, separation anxiety and nap transitions appear on Today based on your baby's age. Short, calm answers to the questions that come up at night are in the Guide too.

OFFLINE FIRST
Everything is written to your device first. You can log, edit and review without a connection. When you are back online, your data syncs to your account. If you would rather not create an account, you can use the app as a guest.

23 LANGUAGES
Choose from 23 app languages in Profile. Time formats follow your region.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Export your records as CSV at any time. Delete your account from inside the app. No ads, no selling of data.

PLEASE NOTE
Nevami is not a medical device or a health service. It does not diagnose, treat or replace advice from a doctor. If you are worried about your baby's sleep, breathing, feeding or development, talk to your pediatrician. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

description:
The world’s No. 1 baby app! Understand why your baby cries more at certain times, isn't himself or herself and... what you can do to help.

During our research, which began in 1971 with Jane Goodall and the chimpanzees in Tanzania, we discovered that babies are more prone to cry and to be clingy or cranky from time to time. This behavior was shown to be related to a leap in the baby's mental development. More specifically, babies go through 10 mental leaps in the first 20 months of their life. A leap may be tough, but it's a positive thing: it gives your baby the opportunity to learn something new.

Use The Wonder Weeks app to:
- See when a leap starts and ends thanks to a personalized leap schedule
- Be automatically notified when a leap is about to start
- Learn to recognize the leaps based on the various signals your baby gives
- Discover the new skills your baby develops with each leap
- Stimulate your baby's new skills with 77 playtime games
- Keep track of your baby's development in your personal diary
- Link the app to your partner's app to keep track of your baby's developments together
- Share your experiences and ask questions in the forum
- Watch fun and interesting videos about parenting
- Complete fun polls and find out what other parents think about certain topics


Our mission is to help parents gain confidence in the face of the greatest leap in life: having a baby. We take a candid look at parenting, shed light on all sides and are there for all parents. We can all help each other and learn from each other.

Millions of parents before you have already followed, supported and stimulated the 10 leaps in the mental development of their babies. It's not a coincidence that we have been one of the best-selling baby apps worldwide for many years!

name: Caregiver: Elderly Care Log
description:
Caring for aging parents is rarely a one-person job. Reminders, doctor visits and "did anyone pick up the prescription?" messages pile up in a group chat until something slips. Caregiver Planner gives a family caregiver one calm place to organize elder care: medication reminders, tasks, appointments, a care log and the numbers you call most.

It is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not a medical app. It helps you plan, remind, hand over and keep track. It never gives dosing, diagnosis or treatment advice.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Profile: add the person you look after, whether a parent, a spouse or someone else, with a relationship and notes.
• Medication reminders: add each medication as printed on the label and the times you want a reminder. Log each one as taken or skipped, or snooze it for 15 minutes. The app reminds you of the time only and never suggests what or how much to take.
• Tasks: add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic", note who is doing it, set a due date and check it off.
• Appointments: keep doctor and specialist visits with the provider, place and notes, and get a reminder before each one. After a visit, write down what was decided and turn follow-ups into tasks.
• Log: note visits, calls and updates. Group entries into concern threads ("sleep at night", "swollen ankle") so you can tell a clinician how long something has been going on.
• Contacts: save doctor, pharmacy, nurse and family numbers, and pin two to Today for a one-tap call.
• Rotation: set a weekly pattern of who is on duty and when, with an end-of-shift reminder.
• Handoff brief: reminder times, the next tasks and appointments, recent updates and who to call, ready to send to a sibling or save as a PDF.
• A weekly recap you can share, and a log export as a PDF for your own records.
• Prep checklists: pick a situation (specialist visit, hospital discharge, home safety, organizing medications, new diagnosis questions, in-home help, documents) and get an organizational checklist of questions to ask, papers to bring and jobs to divide up.

FREE TO START, NO SIGN-UP

Start as a guest right away; your plan stays on your phone. The free version covers one person:
• up to 5 active medication reminders
• unlimited tasks, appointments, log entries and contacts
• handoff brief, weekly recap and PDF export
• one AI checklist to try

The free version shows ads: banners for our other apps and an occasional full-screen ad after you save a task or an appointment.

PRO, FOR FAMILIES WHO SHARE THE LOAD

• Care Circle: invite siblings and other helpers with a code and post tasks, log notes and duty shifts to a shared feed everyone in the circle sees. It updates when the app opens or when you refresh.
• More than one person, each with their own Today, tasks and schedule.
• Unlimited medication reminders.
• Unlimited AI prep checklists, plus AI visit preparation and follow-up suggestions (up to 30 a month).
• Cloud backup and restore (with a free account).
• No ads.

Pro is a monthly or annual subscription. The free senior care organizer stays useful on its own.

YOUR DATA

As a guest, your plan is stored on your phone. Care Circle and cloud backup store the shared or backed-up items on our servers. AI checklists and suggestions are drafted by a third-party AI service (OpenRouter), only after you agree; medication names and recent log entries are sent only if you switch that option on. We use Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, and Google AdMob for ads in the free version.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

Caregiver Planner helps you coordinate the day-to-day of looking after an elderly parent or loved one. It does not provide medical, dosing or health advice. For any medical question, consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Privacy Policy: https://www.coddykit.com/terms/privacy-policy

name: Elderly Care Log: Carer Diary
description:
Looking after an elderly mum, dad or relative? Elderly Care Log is a simple carer diary for senior care at home: write down what happened and when, so you are not relying on memory at the GP surgery, a hospital appointment or a handover to another family member.

WHAT YOU CAN LOG
• Medicines – a straightforward medication log: name, type (tablet, liquid, inhaler, drops and more), dose and the time it was given
• Symptoms – pick from common symptoms such as cough, headache, nausea or joint pain, add your own, and rate how severe each one is
• Temperature – in °C or °F, with colour cues so higher readings stand out

• Notes – meals, sleep, mood, activity, questions for the doctor or anything else worth remembering

SEE THE DAY AT A GLANCE
Every entry goes into a clear daily timeline. Use the calendar strip to move between days, open History to look back over past weeks, and check simple charts for temperature, medicines and symptoms to see how things have changed over time.

MORE THAN ONE PERSON
Caring for both parents, or a grandparent as well? Add a separate profile for each person you look after. Each profile keeps its own records, so nothing gets mixed up.

READY FOR APPOINTMENTS
Export a PDF or CSV file for the date range you choose and share it the usual way – email, messaging or print – with a GP, nurse, pharmacist or another family carer. A written record makes it easier to answer "When did this start?" and "What did they take, and when?"

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account to create. Your records are stored on your phone. The app does not sync between devices, so if several carers are involved, one person can keep the log and share an export when needed.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Adult children caring for an elderly parent
• Family carers and caregivers sharing the load with siblings
• Families supporting a parent living with dementia who want a written history of day-to-day changes
• Anyone keeping a care diary during illness, recovery or day-to-day support at home

IMPORTANT
Elderly Care Log is a record-keeping tool for carers. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always follow the advice of a GP, pharmacist or other qualified health professional. In an emergency, call 999. For urgent advice that is not an emergency, contact NHS 111.

name: Elder Care: Pill Reminder Log
description:
Elder Care is a free medicine reminder and personal health record built for older adults and the family members who look after them. Big text, plain words, one-tap answers — and everything stays on your own phone.

NEVER MISS A DOSE
• Reminders at the exact time you set — not "sometime in the next 15 minutes"
• Answer from the notification: "I took it" or "Remind me later"
• Every schedule real prescriptions use: daily, set weekdays, every few days, monthly, every N hours, cycles like 21 days on / 7 off, and as-needed
• Steroid tapers and short courses: the dose steps down on its own and reminders stop on the last day
• "With food / before food / empty stomach" printed on the reminder itself
• Double-dose check: if you already took it minutes ago, the app asks before recording another
• Skip with a reason ("felt unwell", "ran out", "doctor said stop") — the reason goes into your doctor report
• Refill warnings in days, not just tablets — and a warning if a course cannot be finished with what is left
• Reminder health check: send yourself a test alert, and get step-by-step battery fixes for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, OnePlus, realme, TECNO and more

SCAN A LABEL INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at the box. Name, strength, form and directions are read on the phone — nothing is uploaded — and you check them before saving.

TRACK HOW YOU ARE DOING
• Blood pressure, blood sugar, pulse, oxygen, temperature, weight, breathing, sleep, water, steps
• Pain and mood on a faces scale — no arithmetic while you are hurting
• mg/dL or mmol/L, kg or lb, °C or °F — your choice
• Trend charts with the commonly published range shown for context
• Symptom diary with the medicine you suspect — the app counts and dates them for your appointment, and never claims a cause

KEEP YOUR PAPERS
Photograph prescriptions, lab reports, X-rays, hospital letters and vaccination cards. Search them by the words on the page. Lab values are read off a scanned report and offered for you to confirm — with the range your own laboratory printed.

LAB RESULTS
130 common tests — HbA1c, creatinine, cholesterol, TSH, vitamin D and more — with history and charts per test.

READY FOR THE DOCTOR
• Doctor report PDF: what was taken, what was missed and why, readings, symptoms
• Readings export as PDF or CSV, choose the dates per metric
• Visit preparation: what to mention and what to ask, assembled from your own record
• Family update: a short plain-text message for whoever helps you
• Wallet-sized emergency card with allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts

MADE FOR OLDER EYES AND HANDS
Four text sizes, stronger-contrast mode, dark mode, full-width buttons, no long-press secrets, spelled-out "Required" instead of a tiny asterisk, and every date written out in words.

TWO PEOPLE, ONE PHONE
Keep separate records for yourself and the person you care for, and switch with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No analytics. No ads. No subscription. Your record is encrypted on this phone and the key stays in your phone's own secure keystore. Sharing a report, a card or a backup is a file you hand over yourself. Uninstalling removes everything.

Elder Care records what you tell it and shows it back to you. It does not diagnose, dose or replace your doctor or pharmacist.

Free forever. Made with care for the people who need it most.

name: Senior Helper: Elderly Aid
description:
Watching a parent or grandparent struggle with small buttons, confusing menus and accidental taps on a smartphone? Senior Helper solves that.

Senior Helper is a phone app for older adults and the visually impaired. The home screen shows just four large buttons. Each fills a quarter of the screen. Big icons, big text, nothing else. No ads, no popups, no clutter.

📞 PHONE
A dialler where every digit fills a third of the screen width. Plus key for international numbers. The call button is full-width and green. The contacts list shows names large and phone numbers below. Contacts can be added manually or imported from the phone's address book one at a time or all at once. The delete button is small to avoid accidental taps. When more than five contacts are saved, a separate selection mode appears for deleting many contacts at once.

🔦 FLASHLIGHT
One tap from the home screen turns the flashlight on. The icon changes immediately, the off-state bulb becomes a bulb with rays so you can see at a glance that the light is on. Five minutes later it turns off automatically, so the battery won't drain if it was left on by accident.

🚨 SOS EMERGENCY
In a moment of panic or sudden illness, an older person may struggle to remember a phone number or even who to call. Senior Helper takes that pressure away. The large red SOS button is right there on the home screen. One tap, and they know the right person will be reached - no numbers to recall, no menus to navigate, no decisions to make under stress.

A thirty second countdown starts on tap. The cancel button is full-width and taller than any other button. During the last fifteen seconds it flashes white and red to make accidental taps impossible to miss. When the countdown ends, the app calls a previously chosen contact. The SOS contact can be entered manually or picked from the phone's contacts list. One number, one action, no confusion.

🔍 MAGNIFIER
The phone's camera becomes a digital magnifying glass. The zoom-in and zoom-out buttons are large. A built-in light helps in low-light conditions, the rear flash turns on and the camera view brightens. Useful for reading medication labels, price tags or newspapers.

🔐 PRIVACY
Senior Helper does not collect, transmit or share your data. Contacts stay on your phone. The camera is used only for the flashlight and magnifier, never for taking pictures or video. No internet required. No ads.

👨‍👩‍👧 GREAT FOR FAMILY HELPERS
A family member can install the app on grandma's or grandpa's phone, set the SOS contact to their own number, and add a few contacts up front. After that, the senior uses the app independently with no guidance.

Simple, big, in plain English. The way a phone for an older adult should be.

name: Elderly Safety Assistant

monitor one or more clients, switch between them, view their latest location, manage safe zones and coordinate care with notes, appointments and medication
entries.

Key features:

- Secure client-caregiver pairing with a short code or QR scan
- Background location sharing from the client phone, with permission
- Large SOS button for urgent help requests
- Battery and last-active status so caregivers know if a phone may be offline
- Safe zones with alerts when a client enters or leaves a configured area
- Shared notes for care updates
- Private notes visible only to the author
- Shared appointments and medication lists
- Multiple caregivers per client and multiple clients per caregiver
- Content-free push notifications for SOS and safe-zone events

Location sharing starts only after pairing is accepted. Clients and caregivers can remove a link at any time. Location, SOS-location and safe-zone data are end-
to-end encrypted between paired devices.

Client Safety Assistant is designed for care coordination and safety awareness. It does not replace emergency services, professional medical care or direct
supervision. In an emergency, contact local emergency services immediately.

What’s New

In-App Prominent Disclosure Text
Allow background location so your linked caregivers can see your last known location and receive SOS and safe-zone alerts when this phone is locked or the app
is closed. Your location is shared only with caregivers you approve.

Data Safety Summary
Data collected: precise location, battery/status data, SOS alerts, profile name/photo, notes, appointments, medications, push notification token and technical
operational data.

Purpose: app functionality, care coordination, safety alerts, account pairing, security and troubleshooting.

Sharing: data is shared with actively paired clients/caregivers and service providers used to operate the app, including Supabase and Firebase Cloud Messaging.

Security: data is encrypted in transit. Location, SOS-location and safe-zone data are end-to-end encrypted between paired devices. Notes, appointments and
medications are protected by access controls but are not currently end-to-end encrypted.

Deletion: users can remove pairings in the app and request account/data deletion via info@nextact.is.

name: Pet Pill Reminder & Tracker
description:
Pet Pill Reminder & Tracker keeps every pet's medication routine organized, accurate, and easy to review — and now your whole family can share it.

It is built for pet owners who need more than a basic alarm. Track medications for dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, reptiles, and other pets, then log what was given, skipped, early, or late.

NEW: FAMILY SHARING

- Care together - Share pets, medicines, photos, and dose history with the people who help.
- See who gave each dose - Everyone sees who gave it and when, so no one gives a double dose.
- Invite with a link - Family members join free with their own Google account.
- Export for the vet - Everyone in the family can export CSV and PDF records.
- Your data stays yours - Shared records live in a file in the family owner's Google Drive. We never store them.

FEATURES:

- Medication reminders - Set daily, every-other-day, weekly, or every-few-days schedules (like every 30 days for monthly preventives).
- Multi-pet support - Keep each pet's medications and records separate.
- Dose tracking - Record tablets, half tablets, syringes, drops, liquids, capsules, and more.
- Inventory tracking - Enter current supply and low-supply thresholds, then let logged doses update stock automatically.
- Low inventory alerts - See when a medication is running low before you miss a refill.
- Accurate dose history - Review scheduled time, given time, skipped doses, and late doses.
- Editable given times - Correct a logged time from the History screen.
- Early logging support - Log a dose up to one hour before the scheduled time.
- CSV and PDF export - Share medication records with your veterinarian or keep a backup.
- Follow-up reminders - Get an extra reminder if a scheduled dose has not been logged.
- Dark mode - A calmer view for evening care routines.

name: Pet Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
A simple pet pill reminder and pet medication tracker for dog and cat owners. Add your dog or cat, add each medicine as your vet prescribed it with the time it is due, and get a reminder on your phone when it is time. Tap Log dose or Skip, and the Today view moves on to the next one — no sticky notes on the fridge, no guessing whether this morning's tablet already went in.

Everything you log becomes a medication history for your dog or cat: what was given, what was skipped and what was missed, day by day. Before a checkup or a refill, Pro lets you export a vet-ready summary of that history and share it with the clinic or another caregiver.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Today view — what is due next, today's schedule and anything missed across all your pets, with Log dose, Skip and Undo
• Pet pill reminder — a notification at each scheduled time with the medication name and your animal's name
• Medication schedules — a daily reminder time, a start date and an optional end date for a course; with Pro, several times a day or only on chosen weekdays
• Pet profiles — name, dog or cat, and a photo, each with its own medicine list
• Any medicine — antibiotics, heart medication, joint supplements, dewormers, flea and tick or heartworm prevention. You type the name and the dose exactly as prescribed
• Notes on each medicine — with food, from the prescription label, anything worth remembering
• History — everything given and skipped, grouped by day, with a filter for each animal
• Vet-ready summary (Pro) — export the log as text and share it from your phone
• Several animals — filter the Today view and the history by name when several of them are on different medicines
• Available in 10 languages

WHY A PET MEDICATION REMINDER
• Built for pets — each dog or cat has its own list, so you always know which pill is due and for whom
• A pet pill reminder that lives on your phone — alerts are scheduled locally, so they still arrive when you have no signal
• An honest record — Log dose, Skip and Undo write down exactly what happened, so the record you show your vet is real
• Simple for one animal, useful for several — one pet medication reminder for a single daily tablet, or for a few animals on overlapping courses

WHO IT IS FOR
• Dog and cat owners whose animal is on a course of medication
• Homes with several dogs or cats taking medicines at the same time
• Owners managing long-term pet meds — heart conditions, arthritis, allergies — or monthly flea, tick and heartworm prevention
• Anyone who wants a pet medication tracker and a clean log for the vet instead of relying on memory

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 2 pets, unlimited medications, one reminder time a day per medication, the Today view, logging and the full history in the app. The free version shows ads.
Pro: unlimited pets, several reminder times a day, weekday schedules, the vet-ready history export, and no ads. Pro is an optional in-app purchase. The price is shown in the app before you buy, and a subscription can be cancelled at any time in your Google Play account.

YOUR DATA
Your pets, medications, history and photos are stored on your phone and are not uploaded. When you start, the app opens an anonymous guest session (creating an account is optional). It uses Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, RevenueCat for purchases, and an ad service in the free version. You can delete your account from Settings.

IMPORTANT — NOT VETERINARY ADVICE
This app is a reminder and record-keeping tool, not veterinary advice. It does not diagnose, prescribe, calculate or check a dose, and never tells you whether a medicine or an amount is safe for your animal. Enter the dose exactly as your vet prescribed, and ask your vet about any medical question, a missed or double dose, side effects or an emergency. Phone settings can delay or block notifications, so do not rely on the app alone for critical medication.

name: Petpoopy: Pet Poop Tracker
description:
Your dog or cat cannot tell you something is wrong. Their stool can, and it usually says it first.

Petpoopy is a stool diary that pays attention. You log what you saw in a few taps, and it keeps the story straight so that when you are sitting in the consulting room you are not trying to remember whether the bad week was three weeks ago or five.

The part most trackers leave out Petpoopy does not just write things down. It watches for the things that warrant a phone call and says so plainly: blood, black or tarry stools, straining, a stretch of loose days that has gone on too long. Straining in a male cat gets its own full-screen warning, because that one can turn serious within a day and it is easy to mistake for constipation.

It never tells you what is wrong with your pet. It tells you when it is worth asking someone who can.

Log it in seconds

A three-way choice for the everyday log, or a seven-point picture scale when you want to be precise. It is the Purina scale, made for dogs and cats, not the human chart.
Colour, blood, mucus, straining, worms, volume, and where it happened.
Up to four photos, kept on your phone and nowhere else.
"I did not see it" is a valid answer, for outdoor cats and for the hours you were not there.
One page for your vet A single PDF with the headline first: how many stools, how many were loose, the red flags with their dates, a consistency chart, weight, worming and vaccination dates, and the full diet history laid out the way a vet's nutrition form expects. Readable in about ninety seconds, which is roughly what you get.

It learns what normal looks like Every animal is different, so Petpoopy spends the first week working out what is usual for yours before it starts comparing. After that you get a plain-language score, a calendar you can see a bad patch in at a glance, and patterns worth knowing: the time of day, the day of the week, and which of your own trigger tags line up with the rough days.

More than stool Weight, worming, flea treatment, vaccinations, and every food, treat and chew. Not because a poop app needs them, but because a vet asks for all of it at a gut consultation, and a weight loss of a few percent is the thing an owner genuinely cannot see.

Yours, and only yours

No account. Nothing to sign up for.
Your logs and photos stay in this app on this phone. There is no cloud copy and no server to send them to.
No ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs watching you.
Export everything whenever you like, as JSON or as a zip with the photos.
The only network use is Google Play handling the optional purchase.
Free, with one optional purchase Logging is free. Every safety alert is free, always, for as many days as you use the app. Petpoopy Pro is a single payment, not a subscription. It adds a second pet and beyond, the vet report, trends and patterns, history past thirty days, and the photo archive export.

A note on what this is: Petpoopy is a record you keep, not a diagnostic device. It does not analyse your photos, it stores them. Everything it shows you is a summary of what you told it. Anything worrying is a reason to ring your veterinary practice, and Petpoopy will say so.

Equipped with monthly overviews and in-depth stats, you’ll have the tools to track your pet’s health trends and discuss any concerns or changes more effectively at every vet visit.

Take control of your pet’s digestive health today with Poopi, inspired by Jack and made for all pet parents!

Key Features:

* Poop Tracking: Log your dog's bowel movements quickly and easily to track date, time, and type—just like we did for Jack!
* Health Indicators: Monitor poop consistency, color, and frequency to detect potential health issues early on.
* Detailed Stats: Key stats to share with your veterinarian for improved diagnostic accuracy.

BODY MAP AND HISTORY

name: PainApp: Chronic Pain Relief
description:
Retrain Your Brain. Reclaim a Life Beyond Chronic Pain.
Still living with chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain—or other persistent pain that just won’t go away? Your pain is real. But it may not be coming from where you think.

Requires Subscription.
Free to download; an active subscription is required to use the app and access all features.

Pain can be learned by the brain—and the good news is: it can also be unlearned. This app helps you understand how chronic pain works and gives you the tools to gently rewire the brain’s pain pathways.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

What You’ll Find Inside the App:
Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Exercises that promote safety, movement, and emotional ease

Gentle coaching on how to retrain your brain using proven techniques

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve
Our built-in pain tracker helps you:

Log and visualize your pain patterns over time

Notice emotional or situational triggers

Spot progress and build momentum

Feel more empowered in your recovery

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.
This is not about positive thinking or ignoring your pain. It’s about giving your brain the right information—and practicing how to respond with calm, not fear. Over time, this helps deconstruct the neural pathways that keep pain alive.

Download Now — Start Rewiring Pain, One Step at a Time
Train your brain. Understand your pain. Live your life again.

This app provides educational content and self-management tools and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.

name: Flarewatch: Rosacea Tracker
description:
Rosacea flares often have more than one cause. Sun, heat, a glass of wine, a hot shower and a stressful week can all pile up on the same day. By the time your face is red, it is hard to remember what came before.

Flarewatch is a diary for that. You log what you were exposed to and when you flared. After a few weeks, it shows you which exposures tend to come before your flares.

LOGGING
An exposure takes about fifteen seconds. Tap what applies (sun, heat, cold wind, alcohol, spicy food, hot drinks, stress, exercise, a skincare product) or type your own. You can also say how much you had.

A flare takes two taps: how bad it is, then Save. One more tap sets when it started, which helps when you log it late. You can also pick what kind it was: flushing, bumps, stinging or dryness. That part is optional.

The app asks for as little as possible, because a diary only helps if you keep it up.

PATTERNS
Flarewatch does not start from a general list of rosacea triggers. It works only from what you log. It waits until it has enough of your days, shows how much data each answer is based on, and tells you when there is not enough yet.

For each suspect you can see how often it was followed by a flare, how often it was not, how much of it you had, and which kinds of flare followed. If stress, poor sleep or your period was behind some flares, open Adjust and tap that tag to leave those flares out. The results are worked out again without them. It also points out pairs of things that look worse together than either one does alone.

Flushing can start within minutes, and exposures add up over a day, so Flarewatch looks at the twelve hours before each flare. You can narrow that to the first four hours, or look at the next day instead. A flush and a crop of bumps often follow different timings, so you can also look at one kind of flare at a time.

PRIVACY
No account and no sign-up. No ads. Your log is stored on your phone. We do not run a server, so there is nowhere for it to be sent. Apart from a routine check for app updates, the one thing the app sends anywhere is your subscription status, under an anonymous ID, to RevenueCat. You can export your log as JSON or CSV at any time, and delete all of it from inside the app.

FREE FOR 30 DAYS, THEN $2 A MONTH OR $10 A YEAR
Everything is unlocked for the first month. After that it is a subscription: $2 a month or $10 a year, with no ads and all future updates included. If you do not subscribe, you can still open the app, see everything you have logged, and export it.

The trial is 30 days because it takes about that long to see anything. Dermatologists usually suggest keeping a trigger diary for at least two weeks, so a shorter trial would end before you had seen any results.

This app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It shows you patterns in what you chose to log — nothing more. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

name: TrackerControl Slim
description:
TrackerControl Slim is an Android app that allows users to STUDY the widespread, ongoing, hidden data collection in mobile apps about user behaviour (‘tracking’).

To detect tracking, TrackerControl combines the power of the Disconnect tracker list, used by Firefox, and our in-house tracker list, created from analysing ~2 000 000 apps!

Additionally, TrackerControl detects tracker libraries in apps using the signatures from ClassyShark3xodus/Exodus Privacy for the analysis of tracker libraries within app code.

The app also aims to educate about your rights under Data Protection Law, such the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Under the hood, TrackerControl uses Android’s VPN functionality, to analyse apps’ network communications locally on the Android device. This is accomplished through a local VPN server, to enable network traffic analysis by TrackerControl. To establish this VPN, TrackerControl expands on the work from NetGuard.

No root is required, other VPNs or Private DNS are not supported. No external VPN server is used, to keep your data safe!

name: MedRecap: Doctor Visit Notes
description:
Never forget what your doctor said.

MedRecap is a doctor visit recorder and note-taker for patients. Record your doctor appointment on your phone, and MedRecap transcribes it and writes a clear, plain-language visit summary — what was discussed, what changed, and what to do next. Your medical notes, medications, and follow-ups stay organized in one place.

WHAT MEDRECAP DOES FOR YOU

• Record any doctor visit — in person or over the phone — with one tap
• Get a plain-language visit summary written for patients, not doctors
• Automatically pull out follow-up tasks, so nothing falls through the cracks
• Catch medication changes your doctor mentioned, with medication reminders
• Keep a personal health record — conditions, allergies, surgeries — that updates after each visit
• Ask Lumi, your AI assistant, questions about your own past visits
• Share a visit summary with family or a caregiver — they can read it without the app
• Log daily symptoms and see trends over time
• Plan appointments with reminders and questions to ask

GREAT FOR
• Seeing specialists for an ongoing condition
• Helping a parent or family member keep track of their appointments
• Anyone who walks out of an appointment and thinks "wait, what did they say?"

YOUR PRIVACY, PROTECTED

Your health information is confidential. MedRecap never sells your data or uses it for advertising.Your recordings are deleted right after they're transcribed. Your summaries are encrypted and private to you unless you choose to share them. The transcript is kept securely behind the scenes, where it's used to create your summaries and answer your questions in Lumi.

FREE TO START

Record visits, get summaries, manage medications and appointments, and share with family for free. MedRecap Plus adds summaries kept forever, detailed and translated summaries, unlimited questions to Lumi, and advanced tracking (blood pressure, glucose, and more). 7-day free trial.

Please ask your doctor before recording a visit.

MedRecap is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Always follow the guidance of your healthcare provider.

Waiting List Management: Queue appointments to easily fill free slots when they become available.

🗂️ Complete Medical Records

Digital Database: Store full patient histories, notes and diagnoses (ICD-10 supported).

Multimedia Support: Attach X-rays, lab results or patient-related images directly to a patient profile.

Easy Import: Quickly import patients straight from your phone contacts.

⚡ Efficiency Tools for Your Practice

Smart Patient Reminders: Dramatically reduce no-shows by sending appointment reminders to patients via WhatsApp or SMS.

Templates: Create custom templates for questionnaires, prescriptions and recurring notes to save typing time.

History Tracking: Instantly see the history of all previous visits with a specific patient.

🔒 Privacy, Security and Compliance

Offline First: Your data belongs to you. Like a private medical notebook, patient records stay strictly on your device, not on external servers or web portals.

GDPR Compliance: We follow strict privacy rules. Any app telemetry or statistics collection is completely anonymous.

Never Lose Data: The app creates automatic daily local backups. With the PRO version, the backup is also saved to your own Google Drive, so you can restore your history on a new phone.

name: DrHouse: Online Doctor Service
description:
✓ Choose a doctor you like and get a diagnosis & treatment in minutes.
✓ Pick up an Rx from your preferred pharmacy or use our convenient 1-hour Rx delivery².
✓ Request a work/school excuse if needed.
✓ Insurance is accepted but not required.

Our online doctors are available 24/7 in all 50 states, even on holidays.

At DrHouse, we offer comprehensive and cost-effective virtual doctor services. Our highly trained physicians are specialized in 14 different medical specialties (including family physicians, pediatricians, OB-GYNs, cardiologists, internal medicine doctors, and more), providing the highest quality of care. All DrHouse providers are MDs and DOs. Our physicians are in-network with Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, UnitedHealthcare, Medicare, and other major insurance providers.

What do we offer?

✓ 24/7 virtual visits - See board-certified physicians from the top U.S. medical schools within minutes for an online doctor visit.
✓ Rx as needed¹ - See our physicians whenever you need a new Rx or refill/renew an existing Rx. In select areas, we can deliver prescription medication to you within one hour of your visit.²
✓ Doctor's notes - Get a doctor's excuse and/or clearance for your school or work if needed.
✓ On-demand support - Chat with our support whenever necessary. They are here for you 24/7.

How does it work?

1. Download the DrHouse online doctor service app to schedule a visit with a doctor. The visit will take place in the DrHouse app.
2. Get an Rx¹ and/or doctor's note¹ - Pick up an Rx from your preferred pharmacy. In select areas, we can deliver prescription medication to you within one hour of your visit.²

Our pricing:

A one-time visit costs $0 to $129, depending on your insurance.³ You can pick up and pay for your medications at your preferred pharmacy, or we can deliver them to you within one hour of the visit (available in select areas).²

We offer a world-class care team:

✓ Our online doctors are board-certified and trained in top U.S. medical schools, with an average of more than 20 years of experience.
✓ They are qualified to diagnose and treat various non-emergency conditions.
✓ We approach patient care with the best clinical practices to provide a seamless healthcare experience.

What we treat:

Our physicians diagnose and treat a wide range of medical conditions, caring for patients from birth. Our physicians treat for example, UTIs, Cold/Flu, Sinus infections, Cough, Fever, Headaches, Nausea, Wheezing, Fatigue, Allergies, Back pain, Stress & Anxiety, Depression, Erectile Dysfunction, Weight Loss, STDs, Hair loss, Blood pressure, Cholesterol, Minor sports injuries, Vaginal infections, Acne, Dandruff, Rosacea, Sunburn, Birth control, Menstrual problems and more.

Your medical information, health records, and doctor's visit are confidential and HIPAA compliant. Additionally, DrHouse is a LegitScript-certified healthcare provider.

¹Having a visit does not guarantee a medication will be ordered or refilled. It is our physicians' professional decision. Our physicians don't prescribe gabapentin, medical marijuana, or controlled substances! Your provider may recommend follow-up care, including additional services (for example, labs) that may not be included in the visit price.

²Our 1-hour prescription delivery is available in select areas nationwide. We are opening new delivery areas every week. If the delivery is available in your area, an app screen displaying the delivery information will be presented to you as an option when completing the intake form.

³DrHosue does not offer any subscriptions or memberships, and the pricing is for one-time visits. Most major insurance and HSA/FSA cards are accepted.

description:

Plan one job or one agency assignment with shifts, rotations, calendar views, scheduled gross-pay estimates, reminders, a next-shift widget and file backups. Agency and payer details are organized locally.

Pro is a one-time purchase with no subscription, available through Google Play in supported regions. The United States price is US$9.49; Google Play displays your region's price before checkout.

All 27 current profession and shift themes are free. No additional theme pack is currently required or offered. Choose Follow system, Light or Dark appearance. Themes personalize colors and artwork without changing schedule or pay rules.

WHAT IS BLUE LIGHT?
Blue light is the visible light spectrum (380-550nm) for circadian regulation. It contains more energy than other visible light types, so it may damage your retinal cells.

WHY SHOULD I USE BLUE LIGHT FILTER?
Research shows that exposure to blue light imposes serious threats to retinal neurons, causes eye strain, dry eyes, and inhibits the secretion of melatonin, a hormone that influences circadian rhythms. With our night shift function, your vision health will be greatly improved.

CAN BLUE LIGHT FILTER IMPROVE MY SLEEP?
Yes. Natural exposure to blue light during the daylight hours boosts people's energy, alertness and mood; however, it will disturb your sleep at night.(from wiki) Blue light filter can effectively reduce blue light from the screen and help you get better sleep.

RELEVANT SCIENTIFIC STUDIES 
1. Steven W. Lockley, George C. Brainard, Charles A. Czeisler. “High Sensitivity of the Human Circadian Melatonin Rhythm to Resetting by Short Wavelength Light”. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2003 Sep;88(9):4502-5.

Wake up tired even after a full night’s sleep? NiceSleep helps you understand what happens while you sleep—from sleep cycles and snoring to sleep talking and bedtime habits.

Track your sleep, record nighttime sounds, relax with sleep music and white noise, and receive clear insights that help you build a healthier sleep routine.

TRACK YOUR SLEEP

Use NiceSleep as your personal sleep tracker to monitor:

• Total sleep time
• Sleep quality and sleep score
• Light, deep and REM sleep estimates
• Bedtime and wake-up time
• Nighttime awakenings and sleep consistency
• Weekly and monthly sleep trends

Review each night in a clear sleep report and discover how your habits change over time.

RECORD SNORING AND SLEEP TALKING

Wonder what happens after you fall asleep?

NiceSleep can record nighttime sound events such as:

• Snoring
• Sleep talking
• Coughing and other sleep sounds

Listen to important clips in the morning and use AI-powered analysis to better understand patterns in your nighttime recordings.

GET PERSONALIZED SLEEP INSIGHTS

NiceSleep turns your sleep data into practical information. See how your sleep changes based on factors such as:

• Caffeine
• Alcohol
• Exercise
• Stress
• Late-night meals
• Bedtime routines

Add sleep notes and compare your habits with your sleep quality to learn what may be helping—or disrupting—your rest.

RELAX WITH SLEEP SOUNDS AND MEDITATION

Create a calming bedtime routine with:

• White noise and nature sounds
• Relaxing sleep music
• Guided sleep meditation
• Breathing and relaxation exercises
• Personalized bedtime audio recommendations

Choose the sounds that help you unwind, reduce distractions and prepare for sleep.

WAKE UP MORE GENTLY

Smart Wake helps wake you during a lighter part of your sleep within your selected alarm window, making mornings feel more natural and less abrupt.

BUILD BETTER SLEEP HABITS

Stay motivated with sleep challenges, progress tracking and your Sleep Monster companion. Small nightly actions can help you create a more consistent sleep schedule over time.

WHY CHOOSE NICESLEEP?

• Sleep tracker and sleep cycle analysis
• Snore recorder and sleep talking recorder
• AI-powered sleep and sound insights
• White noise, sleep sounds and sleep music
• Guided meditation and relaxation audio
• Smart alarm and gentle wake-up
• Sleep notes and lifestyle factor tracking
• Weekly and monthly sleep trends

NiceSleep supports your complete sleep journey—before sleep, during the night and after you wake up.

This application is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or medical condition. Sleep stages, sleep scores and sound events are estimates for general health and wellness reference only. For medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

Need help or have feedback? Contact us through the app. We are continually improving NiceSleep to create a better sleep experience.

name: Sleep Calculator
description:
Good day starts with good morning! Go to bed at the right time and wake up in between your natural 90-minute sleep cycles to feel rested and refreshed. A good night's sleep consists of 5-6 complete sleep cycles.

◦ Select when you want to wake up
◦ Calculate your best time to go to sleep
◦ Calculate the best time to wake up

It takes an average human about 15 minutes to fall asleep. If you wake up at one of the calculated times, you'll rise in between 90-minute sleep cycles.

Sleep Calculator helps you decide when to go to bed so that you can wake at a specific time ensuring a good night’s rest, or what time you should wake up if you want to go to bed right now.

If you want to determine your real sleep cycles - our Sleep Tracker functionality allows you to track and analyze your sleep and, if done correctly, will show you your sleep progress – when you were in light, deep or REM (dream) sleep phase and the breakdown of your sleep cycles. Snoring/noise detection can be enabled as well.

name: Sleep Recorder - Sleep Talk
description:

TAP START, THEN SLEEP

ON-DEVICE ANALYSIS

- Sleep talk is turned into text by your phone's on-device speech recognition (Android 13 or later, with the offline language pack)
- Your audio never leaves your phone

MORNING REPORT
- A timeline of the night with every clip ready to play
- Snore score from 0 to 100 that sums up how quiet or noisy the night was
- Restlessness: the motion sensor counts movement while you record
- Share a funny clip with friends

TRENDS
- Week and month charts of snore score, snoring minutes, sleep talk and movement

14 SLEEP SOUNDS
- Rain, ocean, fan, white, pink and brown noise, thunderstorm, fireplace, forest night and more, with a sleep timer

FREE AND PREMIUM
The free version includes recording, sound labels, the morning report, clips from your 3 most recent nights and 3 sleep sounds, and shows ads.
Premium adds sleep talk transcripts, the snore score, trends, the movement chart, unlimited history and all 14 sleep sounds, with no ads.

Subscriptions are billed through Google Play and renew automatically until cancelled. You can manage or cancel them anytime in Google Play > Payments & subscriptions. Eligible new subscribers get a 3-day free trial on the yearly plan; the price is shown before you subscribe.

name: Workspace
description:
Workspace puts your apps on a clear Android Home screen. Open favorites directly and find other apps through search. Use the launcher offline and without an account. Apps highlight as soon as you touch them. The highlight clears when you scroll or release.

FIVE STYLES TO CHOOSE FROM
Classic, Rings, Timeline, Type or Dynamic with colors from your wallpaper. Independently choose light or dark appearance, or follow the system setting.

YOUR APPS, YOUR ORDER
• Create and freely name favorite lists.
• Personal and Business are default list names, not separate accounts.
• Search at the bottom of All apps and show filters when needed.
• Export your launcher configuration.

SEPARATE WORK APPS
Optionally, Android creates a work profile after your consent. Apps there have separate data and sign-ins. The same app can use different personal and work accounts. A favorite list alone does not separate data.

Workspace manages its own work profile locally. Install apps through an available external store in the work profile. Workspace does not install APK files. Open or pause apps and let Android confirm uninstallation. Protection options affect only the work profile. Removing it permanently deletes its apps, accounts and data after confirmation; personal data stays. Device support and existing policies may restrict setup. Profiles managed by others cannot be taken over.

No ads or integrated analytics. Local work-profile management needs no management server. No remote control, kiosk mode, app-download store or central app configuration. Android 12 or later required. You can change your Home app in Android settings at any time.

Swipe right on the Home screen to lock your phone. This shortcut is optional and only works on Home. After locking this way, Android requires your PIN, pattern or password. Fingerprint or face unlock alone will not work. Android requires device administrator approval, limited to locking the screen. This is separate from work-profile management. You can disable this permission here. Android also requires deactivating this lock administrator before uninstalling Workspace.

Choose the Home right-swipe action in Settings: open an app, lock the phone or do nothing. App selection does not place calls. Screen-lock permission is managed separately.

AUTHENTICATOR IN GUARD
Open Guard directly for local TOTP codes, protected by Android authentication and hardware-backed encryption. Add a website’s setup key manually or scan its QR code. Back up and restore accounts through the authenticator settings using a separate passphrase. Keep the encrypted backup outside your phone and its passphrase separately. Without both, Workspace cannot recover lost accounts. Company login approvals remain separate and unavailable.

NEW IN 2.2
Choose a photo, solid color or gradient for your background and portrait, landscape or automatic rotation. Edit authenticator accounts in a compact list with search and copy feedback. 18 languages, 20 variants.

TRUSTED DEVICES
Optionally sync favorite lists and appearance over Bluetooth after QR pairing and confirmation on both devices. Both apps must be visible and phones unlocked. Company sign-ins and device settings stay local. Authenticator transfer sends only a separately passphrase-encrypted backup; the recipient explicitly restores it. Keep an independent backup.

name: Timezone Converter World Clock
description:
Timezone converts a moment between places, keeps a world clock of the cities
you care about, and finds the hours when everybody is awake at once. It works
with no connection at all.

WHAT MOST TIME ZONE APPS GET WRONG

A time zone is not a city, and an offset is not a time zone. A zone is a rule:
a history of offsets and the dates they changed. Almost every converter here
ignores that, looks up two offsets, subtracts them and adds the difference to
the time you typed. That is wrong three ways:

• It uses TODAY'S offsets for a date in July. London is UTC+0 now and UTC+1
then.

• It uses one country's changeover dates for another. America moves its clocks
three weeks before Europe does, so for three weeks every March New York is
four hours behind London, not five.

• It cannot represent the answer at all when the local time it was handed does
not exist, or exists twice.

Here, converting is reading one point on the timeline in another set of rules.
There is no arithmetic to get wrong.

THE TWO MORNINGS A YEAR

On the morning the clocks go forward, an hour of local time does not happen.
There is no 2:30am in New York on 8 March. On the night they go back, an hour
happens twice: 1:30am in London on 25 October is two different moments, sixty
minutes apart.

Almost every app handles this silently — it shows 3:30 when you typed 2:30, or
picks one of the two 1:30s and never mentions the other. This one says so, in a
sentence, and lets you take the second.

It also knows Britain loses a different hour from America: the clocks go
forward at 1am there, so 2:30 is an ordinary time in London that morning and a
missing one in New York.

WHEN CAN WE ALL TALK

Pick two to five places and say what hours each of them works — nine to five,
eight to four, or ten at night to six in the morning. The app shows every
stretch of the day that is inside everybody's window.

It handles the day boundary, because it never works in local dates: Tokyo's
Monday morning really is Los Angeles's Sunday afternoon. And when there is NO
overlap — the honest answer for the Pacific against the American west coast on
office hours — it says so in words, rather than showing an empty strip you will
assume failed to load.

Places forty-five minutes off the hour work properly: India, Nepal, the Chatham
Islands and Eucla are real, and a three-quarter-usable hour is shown as one.

THE CLOCKS

Every city you add, ticking: the local time, whether it is yesterday, today or
tomorrow there, and how far ahead or behind you it is. Every row recomputes
itself every second, so land somewhere and the whole list re-reads itself
against your new zone.

SEARCHING

Type a city, not an abbreviation. Accents do not matter: sao paulo finds São
Paulo and zurich finds Zürich. Abbreviations are never an input, because they
cannot mean one zone — CST is three zones and IST is two — though the app will
show you one beside a place you chose.

The whole IANA database is in the app: every zone, every historical offset.
Nothing is fetched.

ALSO

• 12-hour or 24-hour, or follow the phone
• Compare against the phone's zone, or pin one while you are away
• Light and dark, and Material You if you want it
• Save a copy of your list to a file — this is how you move to a new phone

WHAT IT WILL NOT DO

No location, ever. Detecting which zone you are standing in is the flagship
feature of the paid rivals here and it is refused: the phone already knows its
own zone for free, and every other place on your list is one you typed.

No account, no sync, no server, and no notifications — nothing here will ever
interrupt you. Uninstalling deletes your list, and Save a copy is how you move
it.

Three permissions, all of them for the ads that keep it free.

name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker and plant diary for your houseplants. Log each watering and Ploi learns how often every plant really gets thirsty, then reminds you on a watering schedule that fits your home instead of a generic chart.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can know exactly how often to water a plant: light, humidity, pot size and the season all change the answer. So Ploi works it out from what you do. It looks at the last few waterings you logged, ignores the one-off gaps, and sets the next date from your real rhythm. Prefer a fixed interval for a particular plant? Switch that plant to fixed. Reminders arrive once a day, at the time you choose, as one list of everything that is due.

Reminders for the rest of your plant care

The same schedule works for fertilizing, misting, wiping leaves, repotting and pruning, and you can add care types of your own. Set a task every few days, or tie it to your waterings, such as fertilizer with every other watering.

Your plants on the home screen

Add the Ploi widget to your home screen and see what needs care without opening the app. Small sizes show what is next; the large one is a board of what is overdue, due today and due this week, with the weather where your plants live if you want it. Tap a plant and it opens. You choose what the widget shows and can write your own message for the days when everything is done.

A care log for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline. One entry can hold several kinds of care, a note and photos, and you can edit it later. Long after, you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went between waterings, or the day a new leaf opened. Watered a whole shelf? Select the plants and mark them all at once.

Growth photos and charts

Add photos to a plant or to any log entry and watch its story come together. A monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily looks different six months later, and Ploi keeps every photo. A growth chart tracks height, and a watering chart shows the gaps between waterings so you can spot the odd one out.

Rooms, weather and rain

Group plants by room, shelf or balcony, and mark each spot as indoor or outdoor. Ploi shows the weather where your plants are, and when you log rain, the next watering for outdoor plants moves back to match.

Share the care

Invite a partner, a roommate or a plant sitter. A caretaker can log waterings, notes and photos while you are away, and the history stays with the plant.

Plant care guides and identification

Look up a species in Ploi's care guides for its watering, light, toxicity and pest notes. Not sure what you have? Take a photo, identify the plant and start its care log right away.

Plant wishlist

Keep a wishlist of the plants you want next, so the ones you like are in one place for your next trip to the nursery.

Your records stay yours

Export everything, including your photos, whenever you like.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? Is it growing? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Ploi Pro is an optional subscription for unlimited plants and photos and automatic rain logging.

Terms of Use: https://ploi.me/terms

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: Flora Incognita
description:
FLORA INCOGNITA - DISCOVER THE DIVERSITY OF NATURE

What's blooming? With the Flora Incognita app, this question is quickly answered. Take a picture of a plant, find out what it's called and learn everything you want to know with the help of a fact sheet. Highly precise algorithms based on artificial intelligence identify wild plants even when they are not (yet) in bloom!

In the Flora Incognita app you can easily view all your collected plant finds in a observation list. Maps show where you have found your plants. This way you can see how your knowledge about wild plants is growing.

But Flora Incognita is even more! The app is free of charge and without advertising, because it is part of a scientific research project that aims to improve nature conservation. The collected observations are used to answer scientific research questions that deal, for example, with the spread of invasive species or the effects of climate change on biotopes.

In regular stories, you will learn about news from the project, get insights into the scientific work or will be made curious about what is happening in nature right now.

WHY SHOULD YOU USE FLORA INCOGNITA?
- Identify wild plants simply by taking a photo with your smartphone
- Learn more about plant species with the help of extensive plant profiles
- Collect your findings in your observation list
- Become part of an innovative scientific community
- Share your findings on Twitter, Instagram & Co!

HOW GOOD IS FLORA INCOGNITA?
Species identification with Flora Incognita is based on Deep Learning algorithms that have an accuracy of well over 90%. It is important to take sharp and as close as possible pictures of plant parts such as flower, leaf, bark or fruit for a high identification accuracy.

WOULD YOU LIKE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR PROJECT?
Visit our website at www.floraincognita.com or follow us on social media. You can find us on X (@FloraIncognita2), Mastodon (@FloraIncognita@social.mpdl.mpg.de), Instagram (@flora.incognita) and Facebook (@flora.incognita).

IS THE APP REALLY FREE OF CHARGE AND ADVERTISING?
Yes. You can use Flora Incognita anytime, as long as you want. It is free to use, with no ads, no premium version and no subscription. But maybe you will enjoy searching and identifying plants so much that it will become a new hobby. We have received this feedback many times!

WHO DEVELOPED FLORA INCOGNITA?
The Flora Incognita app is developed by scientists from the Technical University of Ilmenau and the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry Jena. Its development was supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the German Federal Agency for Nature Conservation with funds from the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety as well as the Thuringian Ministry for the Environment, Energy and Nature Conservation and the Foundation for Nature Conservation Thuringia. The project was awarded as an official project of the "UN Decade of Biodiversity" and won the Thuringian Research Award in 2020.
