name: Home Brewing: Beer Recipe Log
description:
Home Brewing is a homebrew log for people who make beer at home. Keep every beer recipe in one place, log hydrometer and temperature readings while the batch ferments, and get your ABV the moment your original and final gravity are in.

YOUR BEER RECIPE BOOK
Write down your malt bill, hop additions, yeast and water notes, then list your mash and brew-day steps in order. Tag each recipe with a beer style — IPA, pale ale, stout, porter, lager, pilsner, wheat beer, sour, amber ale or other.

New to a style? Pick it and tap AI Suggest Starting Recipe: the app fills in a starting malt bill, hops, yeast and steps that you review, change and save as your own.

Tweaking a recipe for the next batch? With Pro, clone it into a new version (v2, v3…) instead of overwriting your notes.

FERMENTATION LOG & ABV CALCULATOR
Add gravity and temperature readings as you take them with your hydrometer and thermometer, each with a date and an optional note, and keep the whole fermentation log for the batch in order. Move a batch from fermenting to conditioning to completed. Enter original gravity (OG) and final gravity (FG) and the ABV calculator works out alcohol by volume instantly.

TASTE, RATE, IMPROVE
Rate a finished beer from 1 to 5 and write tasting notes on aroma, mouthfeel and carbonation. The Stats tab sums up your home brewing: total batches, average rating and the beer styles you make most.

AI BREW ADVISOR
Stuck mid-ferment? The AI Brew Advisor takes the style, your gravity readings, days fermenting and taste-note chips — too bitter, watery, flat, cloudy, too sweet, gravity stalled — and returns a plain-language diagnosis with concrete adjustments for this batch and the next. It is process advice, not a sanitation guide.

FEATURES
• Beer recipe book: malt, hops, yeast, water notes, ordered brew-day steps
• Starting recipe for any style, suggested by AI and ready to edit
• Fermentation tracker with dated gravity and temperature readings
• Automatic ABV from OG and FG
• Batch status: fermenting, conditioning, completed
• Tasting ratings (1–5) and notes
• Stats: total batches, average rating, style breakdown
• Brew Advisor for troubleshooting a batch
• Light and dark themes, 10 interface languages

WHAT'S FREE
Recipes, batches and fermentation log entries are unlimited. Ratings, tasting notes and Stats are free. The Brew Advisor includes 3 free analyses, and recipe suggestions have a monthly free allowance. The free version shows banner ads.

WHAT PRO ADDS
• Unlimited Brew Advisor analyses
• Clone any recipe into a new version
• Version comparison in Stats: batches from v1 and v2 side by side
• No ads

Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription; the price for your country is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account; cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
Your brewing log (recipes, batches, readings, tasting notes) is stored on your phone, with no sign-up form: the app creates an anonymous guest profile so your subscription and free allowances work. When you use an AI feature, the details you entered for that request go through our server to a third-party AI service. The app also uses Firebase (sign-in, analytics), RevenueCat (subscriptions) and Google AdMob (ads in the free version).

FOR ADULTS
Home Brewing is for adults of legal drinking age who make beer at home. It is about the craft — recipes, process and measurements. It does not track how much you drink, does not encourage drinking and makes no health claims. Sanitation and local home-brewing rules are your responsibility.

From your first extract kit to your fiftieth all-grain batch, Home Brewing keeps your beer recipes, fermentation data and tasting history in one brewing log.

name: Brewing Calculator
description:
Brewing Calculator is a focused workbench for adult homebrewers who want to work from their own measurements. Enter the values for a batch and see labeled estimates alongside the equations and assumptions behind them.

Free calculators include:

• Gravity and ABV from your OG and FG readings
• Dilution and boil-off estimates
• Linear scaling of a quantity you enter
• Tinseth IBU and Morey SRM estimates from your inputs

The core calculations work offline and do not require an account. Results update when you change an input. These are simplified estimates, not measurements or safety guidance; review the displayed assumptions before using a result.

Lifetime Pro is an optional one-time purchase for people who want to keep a local batch library. Save and edit batches, duplicate one to explore a variation, compare two saved batches, and export or import JSON files that you choose through Android. Free calculations remain available without the upgrade.

Your draft and saved records stay in app-private storage on your device unless you choose to export a file. The app has no ads, PatchMedia analytics, account, or cloud sync. Google Play handles purchase and restore. Learn more in the privacy policy: https://patch-media.com/privacy/brewing-calculator/

For adult homebrewers evaluating Brewfather, this workbench offers a place to practice beer recipe math with a hypothetical trial batch. Change one entered quantity at a time and inspect the equation, treating the exercise as arithmetic practice rather than a verified brewing procedure.

name: Beer Carbonation Calculator
description:
Force carbonating your homemade beverage (e.g.: beer, ciders, sparkling water, sparkling wine) in your keg requires that you set the correct settings in your CO2 regulator.

This App aims to aid homebrewers in this task, by providing a list of common carbonation values, an easy to use calculator and a table of values by pressure and temperature (commonly known as a carbonation chart) where you can visually find your desired setting.

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

Follow your equipment’s instructions and pressure ratings. Use all applicable safety standards.

name: Brewmaster Calculator Hub
description:
Brewmaster Calculator Hub is a practical brewing calculator toolkit built for homebrewers, craft beer makers, and small-batch brewers who want fast, reliable numbers on brew day.

Designed as a clean utility app, Brewmaster Calculator Hub helps simplify common brewing calculations without digging through spreadsheets, notebooks, or scattered online tools.

Use the app for quick brewing math, recipe planning support, batch adjustments, and measurement conversions while building or refining your beer.

Features may include calculators for:

Original gravity and final gravity
Alcohol by volume estimation
Specific gravity and Plato conversions
Brew efficiency
Priming sugar
Strike water and mash calculations
Dilution and volume adjustments
Unit conversions
Brewing reference calculations
Batch planning support

Brewmaster Calculator Hub is designed for practical use by adult brewers. It does not sell alcohol, facilitate alcohol purchases, or encourage irresponsible drinking. It is a calculation and reference tool for brewing-related measurements.

Built for clarity, speed, and utility, this app gives brewers a simple hub for the numbers that matter.

Important: This app is intended for users 18 and over. Always follow your local laws and regulations regarding brewing, alcohol production, and alcohol consumption.

name: BarVault: Home Bar Inventory
description:
BarVault is a home bar inventory for people who collect bottles: whiskey, bourbon, scotch, gin, rum, tequila, mezcal, brandy, vodka, wine, sake, vermouth and liqueurs. See what you own, what's open, how much is left and what you want to buy next. No account and no sign-up.

Bottles are grouped by product, so three bottles of the same whiskey sit together. A compact list fits a whole shelf on one screen, or switch to cards. Mark each bottle sealed or opened, set how much is left with a slider, and add a photo and notes.

FAST TO ADD

OPENED BOTTLES THAT DON'T LAST
Vermouth, port, sherry, cream liqueurs, wine and sake fade once opened. BarVault suggests a typical number of days after opening, which you can change, and flags bottles before they turn.

EVERY DETAIL A COLLECTOR KEEPS

A WISHLIST THAT SHOPS WITH YOU
Keep the bottles you're hunting for with the price you want to pay. In a shop, type the price and size on the label and see the price per litre and how it compares with your target. Turn on Restock and bottles running low or recently finished show up on the wishlist.

BRING YOUR SPREADSHEET
Import bottles from a CSV file saved in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets: match the columns, check the preview, then add. Export the whole collection to a CSV any time.

FIND ANY BOTTLE
Search by name or brand, even with a typo, and filter by type, opened, sealed, expiring or finished.

BACKUP YOU CONTROL
Save the whole collection to one file, see when you last saved, and restore it on a new phone. Choose replace or merge.

PRIVATE AND CALM
BarVault has no account and no server of its own. Your collection stays on your phone unless you save a backup. Warm dark and light themes. Volumes in ml, cl or fl oz. In English, Russian and Armenian.

FREE AND SUPPORTER

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: Home Bar Hero
description:
Your home bar, unlocked. Spirits and Wine.

Home Bar Hero turns the bottles you already own into a cocktail menu. Snap a photo or search, and every bottle you add reveals new drinks you can actually make tonight.

BUILD YOUR BAR
Stock your bar in seconds. Take one photo of your shelf and AI identifies up to 10 bottles at once, then paints each one as art, so the bar in the app looks like the bar in your kitchen. Scan a wine bottle and the app reads the producer, the varietal, the region, and the year off the label, because for wine the vintage is part of which bottle it is. Your wine lands in the Cellar rather than on the spirits shelf, racked by when it wants to be opened. Tap a bottle and it flips over to a researched back label: what it tastes like, what to eat with it, and the window when it drinks best. Ask what to open tonight and the answer comes from your own rack.

DISCOVER WHAT TO MAKE
Your bar is matched against hundreds of recipes, classics plus seasonal drops, growing every month as members share their own. See what you can pour right now, what you are one bottle away from, and the near misses tagged "Ready, with a sub" with the swap that works. Smart Buy names the single bottle that unlocks the most new drinks on your shelf.

THE BARKEEP, YOUR AI BARTENDER
Chatting with the Barkeep is free on every account. It reads your actual inventory, so it only suggests drinks you can make. It writes the complete recipe right in the chat, measurements and method and glass and garnish, with one tap to save. It checks real published recipes when you want the canonical version of a classic, reads photos of bottles and menus, remembers the conversation, and can stock a bottle for you without you leaving the chat.

THE OPEN BAR
One room every member shares, not a feed. Read the conversation, the tasting notes, the threads, and the Barkeep answering out loud, free on any account. Lurking is welcome. Top Shelf supporters pull up a stool and post.

SHARE YOUR BAR
Friends pull up a stool at your bar as Regulars and see the recipes you choose to share. Every recipe is private by default and you pick the audience per drink. Build drink menus and your guests browse them from one QR code, no app and no login needed. Earn badges as you go.

MORE OF WHAT IT DOES
Flavor Lab: dial in a taste with sliders and the app invents a complete, balanced cocktail, using only your own bottles if you like.
Menu scanner: photograph a restaurant drink list and get the drinks back as real recipes.
Recipe packs: a themed drop of drinks you flip through, save, and make, with more on the way.
Cocktail history: origin stories for the classics.
Export your bar as a spreadsheet, because your bar is yours.
A dark theme built for evening use.

FREE TO START, FAIR FOREVER
No ads. The free tier is a real bar, not a demo: bottle scanning, recipe matching, free chat with the Barkeep, daily AI credits, painted shelf art, saved recipes, badges, a shareable drink menu, and the whole Open Bar to read. The optional Top Shelf upgrade adds a bigger daily AI allowance, your whole bar and cellar painted, as many drink menus as you want, the party hosting tools, and a stool in the Open Bar. Top Shelf is how supporters keep the app running for everybody else.

Whether you are a seasoned mixologist or just getting started, Home Bar Hero helps you make better drinks with what you already have.

Please enjoy responsibly. Home Bar Hero is for adults of legal drinking age.

name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about. InvenDo is a home inventory app for your kitchen and the rest of the house: it keeps track of what you have, where it is stored and when it expires, and reminds you in time.

Scan a barcode or type a name, put the item in a storage place (fridge, freezer, pantry, garage, bathroom cabinet), and you always know what is in the house without going to look.

STOP THROWING FOOD AWAY
- Nothing spoils at the back of the fridge again: give an item an expiry date and it is flagged as Expires soon, then Already expired
- A reminder arrives at the time of day you choose, so you use things while they are still good
- Opened a jar or a pack? Mark it opened, and InvenDo sets a Consume by date from the shelf life you enter once, then remembers it for next time

NEVER RUN OUT OF WHAT YOU ALWAYS NEED
- Coffee, diapers, cat food: set a Minimum quantity and InvenDo tells you before the last one is gone
- Everything below its minimum sits on one screen, ready to go onto the shopping list
- Set the minimum for a whole category, not just item by item

BUY ONLY WHAT IS MISSING
- A shopping list built from what your pantry actually lacks, instead of from memory
- Group the list by store, so one trip covers one shop
- Check things off in the aisle, then move what you bought straight into your inventory
- Send the grocery list to whoever is going out, as plain text

ADD THINGS IN SECONDS
- Scan a barcode to add an item, scan again to take one away
- A scanned barcode can fill in the product name and photo for you (available in many countries, not all)
- Start typing and InvenDo suggests things you have had before

FIND ANYTHING WITHOUT SEARCHING THE HOUSE
- Storage places inside storage places: the freezer, then the top drawer
- Categories with colors, and subcategories when you need them
- Photos of your items and your storage places, and an icon for each storage place
- Unit sizes that add up for you: 1 pack = 6 pcs, or 1 pack = 250 g, with the total on hand
- Search your whole home inventory by name or by voice

KEEP THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD IN SYNC
- Invite your partner, children or roommates by email, and everyone sees the same list as it changes
- Keep several lists (home, parents' house, a hobby collection) and choose who sees which
- People you invite get the paid features on your shared list at no extra cost
- Works offline, syncs when you are back online
- Check the shopping list off from an Android home screen widget, or open your inventory in a browser at web.invendo.app
- Export to Excel whenever you like, or import a spreadsheet you already keep

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants a pantry inventory that is actually up to date. Food in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Medicines and their shelf life. Cosmetics. Clothes you forget you own. Tools in the garage. Hobby collections. Wine, spices, camping gear, baby supplies, printer cartridges. It is built for a household rather than a business, and it is simple enough that the rest of the family will actually use it.

NO ADS, AND A GENEROUS FREE VERSION
The inventory, storage places, categories, the shopping list, barcode scanning, expiry and low-quantity reminders, Excel export, sharing the list, the widget and sync across devices are all free, and there are no ads anywhere in the app. Premium adds photos, storage icons, Excel import, deeper subcategories, extra lists, inviting other people, filling the shopping list from low-quantity items in one tap, and the web app. Take it monthly, yearly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase: pay once and use it forever.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@invendo.app, a real person answers, usually within a day.
Guides and answers: https://help.invendo.app
More about InvenDo: https://invendo.app

• Box scan: one photo of a crate, box or pile and one of its label. Every piece is counted together.

END-OF-SHIFT, SORTED
• Daily report with opening, used and closing stock for every item
• See what was poured, what is left and what to restock

BUILT FOR YOUR TEAM

• Add staff by email. They do not need their own subscription

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL

SEE WHAT IT SAVES

PLANS
You need a subscription to create a venue. Managers and Teammates you add do not pay.

your device.

day a loan is due back, before a return window closes and when maintenance is due.

yours and name the rest.

your phone: your inventory is never sent.
• Check today's price online, and import a CSV from a spreadsheet or another app.

SHARED HOUSEHOLD
• Share one inventory with the people you live with, through a folder in your own cloud drive. Each
phone keeps the whole record; what one adds, changes or removes reaches the others.

MOVING AND STORAGE
• Pack items into boxes and print QR labels. Scan a label and the box opens to its
contents.

THE CLAIM PACKET
• A polished PDF with photo evidence on every line, plus a CSV adjusters use directly.
• Replacement cost and actual cash value per line, with the depreciation rule beside
the figure. A field you skip prints as unknown, never a guess.
• Subtotals per room, the grand total and a signed declaration, like a carrier form.
• Scope it to the rooms an event touched. Page one carries insurer, policy and claim
number.
• After a theft, print the serial register the police ask for.

will.
• Photograph your paper policy: cover, excess and renewal date land in fields you
confirm, and your total is set against them.

A BACKUP YOU CAN TEST
• One tap rebuilds your encrypted backup in a sandbox and shows the restored inventory,
counted and checked.
• When it stops being a drill, put the file back. A restore only ever adds.

YOURS, PRIVATELY
• Your inventory stays on your device, encrypted, unless you export it or share it
with your household. No account, no servers of ours.
• App Lock keeps it behind your device's own screen lock.
• No location, no tracking. The privacy policy matches, word for word.
• Your packet opens in any PDF or spreadsheet app and the backup file is yours.

PAY ONCE

• One purchase unlocks everything, forever.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

Score Counter replaces paper, pen and calculator. Pick a ready-made game or set up your own, add players with one tap, and type in points as you play. The app keeps the score, the standings and the history.

Board games, card games, dice games, darts, golf or a pub quiz — Score Counter is a favorite for Yahtzee, Rummy, Canasta, Uno, Skull King, Scrabble and virtually any game where you add up points.

PLAYING
• Ready-made games: Yahtzee, Rummy, Canasta, Mau Mau, Farkle, Hearts, Uno, Skull King and more, set up in a couple of taps. Most are free; Uno, Skull King and the board game scoresheet are Premium, or unlock one for a single game by watching a short ad.
• Named rounds (Premium, or one ad per game): score rows can carry a name instead of a number — "Upper section", "Buildings", "Trump: hearts". Paste the names in as a list, and edit them straight from the game menu.
• Score chart: see how the scores evolved round by round, right under the final standings.
• Match recap: a one-line summary of the game — the comeback, the close finish, the runaway win — that travels with the result you share.
• Milestones and rivals: the app celebrates a new personal best or a winning streak, and shows each player their rivals.
• Template statistics: standings, win rates and score trends per game, filtered by date range.
• Game rules: a target score or round limit that finishes the game for you, reverse scoring for games where lower is better, a starting player that can rotate each round, and an initial score for games that begin with a balance.
• Live ranking during the game, score editing with a tap on the cell, and finished games you can resume any time.
• Player profiles with win counts, career stats and avatars (Premium).

YOUR DATA
• Game templates (Premium): save players, rules and target score once and start new games in seconds. Give a template an icon and the games started from it wear it too.
• Cloud backup and sync (Premium): sign in with Google or Apple to keep games, players and stats backed up and in sync across your devices.
• Export and import (Premium): games, players and templates to CSV or JSON, and back in from JSON.
• Custom toolbars (Premium): build your own score-input toolbars with the buttons you use most.
• History: every game you have played, searchable, filterable by status, with the leaderboard one tap away.
• Dark, light or system theme with adjustable contrast, and side-by-side layouts on tablets.

PREMIUM
Score Counter is free to use. Premium is a one-time purchase (a monthly plan is available too) that unlocks everything marked Premium above and removes the ads. Some Premium features can be used for a single game by watching a short ad instead.

Focus on the game, not the math!

Found a bug? Send me an email with a short description and I'll fix it as soon as I can. Thank you!

name: The Scorekeeper
description:
The Scorekeeper is the score-tracking app you have been looking for.

Clean, fast, and beautifully designed — it works for any game you play. Cards, dice, board games, sports, pub quizzes, golf — if you keep score, this is your app.

WHY THE SCOREKEEPER IS DIFFERENT

Most scorekeeper apps are clunky, cluttered, or buried in features you never use. The Scorekeeper strips everything back to what matters: a clear view of every player's score, instant updates, and a history that is always there when you need it.

TWO SCORING MODES — YOUR CHOICE

Normal mode lets you type in point totals with a built-in numeric keypad. Perfect for games where you tally up a round total: Rummy, Ticket to Ride, Catan, Golf, Yahtzee, and hundreds more.

One point at a time lets you tap + once per point scored. Ideal for darts, bowling, pub quizzes, or anything you count one point at a time.

Pick the mode that fits your game when you create it — and get started in seconds.

BEAUTIFUL PLAYER COLORS

Create your regular players once and reuse them across every game. Give each player a name and pick a color from 25 vibrant options. Their color runs through the entire game — column headers, score rows, player tags — so you always know at a glance exactly who is winning and by how much.

20 HAND-CRAFTED GAME ICONS

Choose from 20 beautiful icons when you create a game: cards, dice, chess, trophy, crown, puzzle, gem, domino, target, and more. Your game list will finally look as good as the games themselves.

EVERYTHING SAVES AUTOMATICALLY

Walk away. Put your phone in your pocket. Switch apps. The Scorekeeper saves every point automatically to your device. Your games are always right there when you come back, sorted by most recent. No tapping Save, no cloud sync, no waiting.

EDIT AND FIX SCORES INSTANTLY

Mistyped a score? Tap any entry in the score list to edit or delete it. Your entire point history is fully editable, so a single wrong number will never ruin a game.

POWERFUL GAME MANAGEMENT

A clean game list shows all your active games with icons and player colors at a glance. A three-dot menu on any game lets you reset all points, rename the game, swap its icon, add or remove players from an ongoing game, or delete it entirely.

NO ACCOUNT. NO INTERNET. NO NONSENSE.

All data is stored privately on your device. Nothing to sign up for, nothing to pay, and nothing tracking you in the background. Launch the app and start scoring. That is it.

Whether it is family game night, a tournament with friends, a lazy afternoon of cards, or a competitive round of golf — The Scorekeeper is ready in seconds and out of your way the rest of the time.

It is not just a great scorekeeper app. It is the only one you will ever need.

Download it today.

PAY ONCE, KEEP IT

name: Thrift Map: Thrift Store Map
description:
Thrift Map turns secondhand shopping into something you can actually plan.

Open the app and see a map of the secondhand places around you: thrift stores, charity shops, flea markets, antique dealers and vintage boutiques. Move the map anywhere in the world and the shops there appear. No account, no setup.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Find thrift stores near you on one clean map
- Switch to a list sorted by distance, nearest first
- Filter by what you're looking for: thrift, charity, vintage, antiques or flea markets
- Search any city or neighbourhood in the world by name and plan ahead
- Tap a shop for its address, opening hours, phone number and website
- Save places: want to go, been there, favorites
- Put saved places in the order you choose and follow your trip stop by stop
- Saved places keep their address and hours on your phone, for when the signal drops
- Share a shop or a whole trip with a friend
- Open directions with one tap

BUILT FOR THRIFTERS

Charity shop crawls. Flea market Sundays. That one vintage street you heard about in a city you've never been to. Thrift Map is for people who go looking, not just browsing an app, so it stays out of the way: the map is the screen.

NO ADS. EVER.

Thrift Map has no advertising, no analytics and no tracking of any kind. There are no accounts: we never ask for your name, email or phone number.

Your location permission is used on your device to centre the map and sort shops by distance. To draw the map we send the area you are looking at to our server, which gets the shops there from OpenStreetMap and keeps them for the next visit. That area is not linked to your identity; when the map is centred on you, it shows roughly where you are. Your saved places stay on your phone. Apart from OpenStreetMap, nothing is shared with anyone.

SUBSCRIPTION

Thrift Map needs a subscription. There is no free version.

- Plans, any trial or introductory offer and all prices are shown in the app and in Google Play, in your currency, before you pay
- Renews automatically until you cancel
- Cancel any time in Google Play: the app links you straight there

Terms: https://thriftmap.hugosoftware.net/terms
Privacy: https://thriftmap.hugosoftware.net/privacy

ABOUT THE SHOP DATA

Shop listings come from OpenStreetMap, the community-maintained map of the world. Coverage is excellent in some cities and thinner in others, not every shop is on the map, and a listing can be out of date. Please check opening hours before making a trip. If you spot something wrong, you can fix it for everyone at openstreetmap.org.

Shop data and map (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Questions? https://thriftmap.hugosoftware.net/support

description:
Become the manager of a pre-loved goods store (yup, that's just a fancy name for second-hand!) and turn it into a prospering business!

There are many towns for you to operate in, each with a unique customer base and different products for you to discover. You can guess what you'll find in Trendy Town or Totaltoys District, for example!

The product line-up at your store is up to you, of course. Will you be selling model toys, video games, classy suits, cars, plasma TVs, or diamonds? That's the fun in the second-hand retail industry -- you sell all sorts of goods, cherry-picked from a variety of available pre-owned products.

Your store also offers a gift-wrapping service which does wonders for boosting customer satisfaction.

Besides store shelves, you can also have stalls selling donuts or ice-cream, a gaming corner or toy vending machine. They'll draw in more customers, and once your store becomes really popular, even whole groups of kids or curious tourists.

Your field staff are in charge of collecting goods for sale. They'll sometimes come across what looks like real treasure, but you'll have to appraise it first to see what it's actually worth. You may discover some amazing items this way, which will bring fame to your store!

description:

FEATURES

• Every major U.S. coin series — from Indian Head Cents to Morgan Dollars to Saint-Gaudens Double Eagles
• Pricing for every grade, mint mark, proof, specimen, variety, and error
• Live precious-metal melt values for every silver, gold, and copper coin — from real-time spot prices
• Mintage figures so you know how rare each coin really is
• Live eBay listings to see what your coins are actually selling for
• Series Info pages with the story behind every coin design
• Composition + historical melt chart for any coin, with selectable time ranges
• Full Canadian coverage in addition to U.S.

JUNK SILVER & MELT CALCULATOR

The Metals tab shows current silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices alongside the melt value of popular coins:
• 90% silver dimes, quarters, halves, and dollars
• 40% silver Kennedy halves (1965–1970)
• War nickels (1942–1945)
• American Silver Eagles
• Pre-1933 gold ($2.50 / $5 / $10 / $20)
• American Gold Eagles and Gold Buffalos
• Pre-1982 Lincoln cents and large copper coinage

Tap any coin or spot price to see composition, weight, per-metal value, and a melt-value chart you can scrub through.

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS FOR

• Looking up what a coin is worth before selling
• Checking key date premiums (1909-S VDB, 1916-D Mercury, 1893-S Morgan) at a glance
• Estimating melt value on junk silver, war nickels, pre-1933 gold, and copper cents
• Verifying mintage and rarity before bidding on eBay
• Pricing inherited coin collections without a dealer visit

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS NOT

PriceGuide is a price reference, not a collection tracker. To catalog the coins you own — grades, purchase prices, completion progress, portfolio value — use our sibling app LuckyCoin. PriceGuide is for the moment you just need to know "what is this worth, right now."

PRICEGUIDE PREMIUM

Unlock the full app:
• Pricing for every grade (free tier shows two)
• Live spot prices on the Metals tab (free tier shows a one-week-old snapshot)
• Proof and specimen pricing
• Variety and error pricing
• Pricing for Proof Sets and Mint Sets

Subscribe monthly or yearly, or unlock everything once with a Lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Settings.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Q: How accurate are the prices?
A: The database refreshes regularly from auction and dealer data. Actual sale prices vary by grade, eye appeal, and certification.

Q: Does PriceGuide track my collection?
A: No — it's a price lookup reference. For collection tracking, use LuckyCoin.

Q: Are melt values accurate?
A: Yes. Calculated from real-time silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices using each coin's actual composition and weight.

Q: Free or paid?
A: Free with two grade points per coin. Premium unlocks every grade, varieties, errors, proofs, and live melt values.

Q: Privacy?
A: No account required. We don't track your lookups or sell your data.

Made by Stuck at Home, LLC — also behind LuckyCoin (coin tracker), LuckyFind (metal detecting log), LuckyVinyl (records), and the Lucky family of utility and collector apps.

HelloFresh delivers weekly meal kits with delicious, prepped ingredients and easy-to-cook recipes directly to your door. Take the guesswork out of meal planning and cook delicious food for you or your whole family.

Perfect for busy lifestyles, our meal delivery services include everything you need to prepare your favorite meals, with many of our recipes ready in about 30 minutes. We also combine thousands of delicious, carefully curated recipes in our collection, so mealtime is never boring!

HelloFresh is as flexible as you are. Skip a week or cancel your weekly food subscription at any time. The only thing you need to decide is what to make tonight—giving you a fresh and fun cooking experience that puts you in control in the kitchen.

What to Expect from HelloFresh’s Meal Kit Delivery Service
✓ Thousands of delicious and easy recipes that you can save to your favorites, rank, and share with your friends and family.
✓ Fresh ingredients, along with step-by-step recipe instructions with cooking tips & tricks.
✓ The freedom to customize your plate with easy options to swap ingredients or double the protein.
✓ A flexible online account that functions as a meal planner so you can easily choose your meals or change your subscription at any time.

Check out our easy meal kits for every diet type:
🥩Meat & Veggies: A meal plan designed for unfussy omnivores that includes the widest range of meat, fish, and seasonal produce. Enjoy all our recipes with this preference.
🥦 Veggie: A meal kit with a huge range of seasonal veggies, legumes, seeds, and nuts. Everything you need to create vegetarian meals.
🐟 Pescatarian: A meal plan that perfectly balances seafood and veggies to make the most delicious fish-based recipes.
👪 Family Friendly: The perfect meal plan for people of all ages, combining kid-tested meals and family favorites with easy recipes that everyone will love.
⭐ Calories Smart: Keep tabs on your calorie intake with delicious, dietician approved meal kits that are at or under 650 calories each.
⌛ Quick & Easy: Fast, simple, and fresh meal plans that cut down on the prep, cooking, and cleanup every night!

Cookbook feature brings all your dinner inspiration into one place, so you never lose another recipe idea again.
📲 Save from anywhere: Turn cooking videos from TikTok, Instagram, and food blogs into structured recipes in just a few taps.
📖 All your recipes, organized: Keep your saved recipes alongside your HelloFresh favorites — everything in one app.
🆓 Free for everyone: Cookbook is completely free to use, whether you're a HelloFresh subscriber or not.

Easy Meal Management with the HelloFresh Android App
The HelloFresh app makes managing your weekly meal subscription simple. Just access your account on your Android device to manage your delivery day, swap out ingredients and recipes, or change the number of meals or the number of people you are feeding. Perfect whether you’re eating alone or cooking for the whole family!

About HelloFresh
HelloFresh is committed to sustainable eating, and each of our meal delivery kits helps you reduce food waste, lower your carbon footprint, and minimize packaging waste. In fact, we’ve been able to offset 100% of our carbon emissions.

Each of our meal boxes come with perfectly portioned ingredients, with less prep and more great food without the hassle. We source all our ingredients responsibly, and we’re constantly innovating to create smarter packaging to reduce plastic and improve our sustainability goals.

If you need more information about our subscriptions, HelloFresh meal kits, or you need help using the HelloFresh app, contact us today! Follow us on Facebook (fb.com/hellofreshUS) and Twitter (@hellofreshUS). If you like the service, please take a few minutes to review our app.

Find more information at:
https://www.hellofresh.com/

Learn more about our plans here:
https://www.hellofresh.com/plans

name: Eat This Much - Meal Planner
description:
Put your diet on autopilot with Eat This Much, the automatic meal planner. Tell us your diet goals, the foods you like, your budget, and what your schedule looks like, and we'll automatically generate a complete meal plan to meet your requirements. It's like having a personal diet assistant.

⭐ #1 Best Meal Planning App of 2023 - CNN Underscored

Features
•  Generate meal plans that meet your calorie and macro targets in seconds
•  Nutrition targets can be set up for weight loss, maintenance, or muscle / bodybuilding
•  Follow any eating style or create your own
•  Choose from paleo, atkins/keto, vegetarian, vegan, and Mediterranean diets
•  Filter out foods/recipes based on allergies and dislikes, including gluten-free
•  Set the available cooking time for each meal to match your schedule
•  Take the anxiety out of picking what to eat
•  Personalize any of our recipes or add your own
•  Don't like our suggestions? Easily swap them out or configure the meal planner to only use foods you like using Recurring Foods

Premium features
•  Automatically generate a week of meal plans at a time
•  Didn’t follow the meal plans? Easily log what you did eat to track your intake
•  Grocery lists are automatically created from your meal plans
•  Set a number of family members for each meal to make sure you buy enough groceries
•  Reduce food waste with pantry tracking
•  Set custom targets for each day of the week, like more calories and carbs on your workout days. Customize as much or as little as you want.

Normal calorie trackers force you to add foods into your diary one by one. By the end of the day, there's no guarantee that you'll be anywhere near your nutrition targets. With our automatic meal planner, there's nothing to track because everything is already entered for you. All you have to do is follow the plan.

We offer both free accounts and premium accounts. As a free user, you can create a single day meal plan and completely customize it however you want. Each meal can have different preferences, and your nutrition targets can be whatever you like.

As a premium user, you'll have access to the weekly meal planner that allows you to automatically generate a week of meal plans and send them to you with a grocery list via email. As you follow the plans, you can track what you did or didn't eat, and if you deviate from the plans, we make it easy to readjust your targets for the next week to stay on track.

Try out the free account to see if our meal plans appeal to you, and upgrade to the premium meal planner when you're ready.

name: Diet Plan: Meal Planner & Prep
description:
Plan smarter, eat better, and stay on track with a personalized diet and meal planner built around your goals and everyday routine.

Whether you're working toward weight loss, balanced nutrition, or healthier eating habits, AI Diet Planner helps you organize meals, discover healthy recipes, track calories and macros, and build a plan that fits your lifestyle.

Personalized Meal Planning

Take the guesswork out of deciding what to eat. Create a meal plan, organize breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, and plan ahead for the week.

A structured meal plan makes it easier to stay organized, manage your nutrition, and make consistent food choices. Whether you need a simple diet plan or a weight loss meal plan, keep everything in one place.

Explore diet plans that fit different nutrition preferences and goals, including low-carb, keto, vegetarian, vegan, and weight loss meal plans.

Choose the approach that works for you while keeping healthy eating and balanced nutrition at the center of your routine. Having meals planned ahead can make it easier to follow your chosen diet and make thoughtful food choices throughout the week.

Log your meals and monitor your calorie intake while keeping an eye on important macronutrients. Track protein, carbohydrates, and fats with macro tracking to better understand your eating habits and stay aligned with your nutrition goals.

Healthy Recipes & Meal Prep

Find healthy recipes and meal ideas for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks.

Plan meals ahead, explore different food options, and make meal prep easier throughout the week. Whether you're looking for healthy meal ideas or recipes that fit your weight loss goals, you can keep your meal planning organized in one place.

Meal prep can also help simplify busy days by giving you a clear idea of what you're eating ahead of time, making it easier to maintain a consistent eating routine. Explore different meal options and plan ahead so you can spend less time deciding what to eat.

Activity & Lifestyle Tracking

Bring nutrition and activity together in one routine. Track workouts and daily movement alongside your meals and nutrition to get a more complete view of your progress.

You can keep your nutrition and movement information together, making it easier to see how your daily choices fit into your overall routine. Use your tracked meals, activity, and progress to stay organized and maintain a consistent approach to your goals.

Track Your Progress

Keep an eye on your weight, meals, calories, macros, and activity as you work toward your goals.

Set reminders for meals, hydration, and calorie tracking to help you stay consistent with your routine.

Your Complete Diet & Meal Planning Routine

Bring your meals, nutrition, and progress together in one simple routine. Plan meals around your goals, explore healthy recipes, keep track of calories and macros, and stay aware of your activity and progress. With meal and hydration reminders to help you stay consistent, you can make healthy eating easier to manage day by day.

Build healthier eating habits one meal at a time. Plan your meals, understand your nutrition, and stay organized with a diet planner designed to fit your lifestyle.

🧑‍🍳 Plan Your Weekly Menu & Meals

Trying to stay ahead of daily meals? Weekly Menu helps you plan smarter – from solo lunches to full family dinners. Keep recipes organized, prep your grocery list, and turn last-minute food stress into a routine that actually works.

Weekly Menu integrates with Alexa so you can ask what’s on your meal plan for a specific date or meal — or even plan a meal using your voice. It’s a hands-free way to stay on track, even while cooking.

🤖 Let AI Help You Decide What to Cook
Stuck in a rut? Use our meal ideas generator or try the AI meal planner to discover something new. The AI menu generator suggests dishes based on your saved recipes, food preferences, and goals. Build a personal meal plan with recipes that fit your tastes – it’s like having a meal coach in your pocket!

📆 Customize Your Meal Calendar
Keep your week organized with a food planner that does more. Weekly Menu supports recurring meals, rotating menus, and easy meal prep — all in one place. It's built to match your lifestyle, whether you're planning for one or for the whole household.

💰 Track Food Expenses & Save Money
Want to spend less without overthinking it? Weekly Menu includes a simple expense tracker to help you spot where your grocery money goes and make smarter choices - no stress, no complicated budgets.

🥗 Perfect for Healthy Eating & Balanced Nutrition
You don’t need a complicated system to eat well - just a plan that works for you! Weekly Menu lets you lay out your meals, save the recipes you already love, and build a list that actually fits your life. It’s a meal planner that keeps things simple and flexible, day by day.

🎯 Key Features
✔️ Weekly meal planner and daily meal calendar
✔️ Recipe keeper and recipe saver
✔️ Grocery list builder
✔️ AI meal planner and smart meal ideas generator
✔️ Personalized menu planner with recurring meals
✔️ Built-in expense tracker for grocery budgeting
✔️ Works for meal prep, food organizer, and planning all meal times
✔️ Save recipes, plan to eat better, and keep track of everything in one app!

When meals are mapped out in advance, everything else runs smoother. You won’t have to think twice about what to cook or what to buy. Just open your plan, follow your list, and keep things simple.

Planning meals is easier in your own language. The app is available in English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Greek and Chinese.

Download Weekly Menu and get ahead of your food routine. Plan your meals, save recipes you trust, manage your grocery list with ease, and track your spending along the way. Meal planning has never been this simple — or this efficient!

See calories, protein, carbs and more for your recipes. The Planner adds up your daily totals and shows your average for the week.

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler
description:
ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler & Kitchen Converter

Cooking for two when the recipe serves six? Doubling a batch for guests? ScaleChef does the kitchen math for you — and it all works offline, with no account and no ads.

SCALE A RECIPE LIVE
Save a recipe with its ingredient list and original serving count, then just tap the servings up or down. Every quantity rescales instantly, written the way you'd actually measure it — "1 1/2 cups", not "1.4732". No more scribbling on the back of an envelope.

MEASURE BY WEIGHT WHEN IT MATTERS
For baking staples like flour, sugar, and butter, ScaleChef shows a gram estimate next to the cup measurement, so you can switch to a scale for the ingredients where precision counts.

SWITCH BETWEEN US AND METRIC
Flip a whole recipe between US cups/ounces and metric millilitres/grams. ScaleChef picks sensible units for each ingredient automatically instead of leaving you with "0.95 litres".

QUICK CONVERT
Need a one-off answer? Pick a from-unit and a to-unit, type a number, done. Volume and weight, US and metric — plus an optional ingredient-weight estimate.

OVEN & PANS
• Convert oven temperatures between °F and °C, with the matching UK gas mark
• Find a substitute baking pan — ScaleChef ranks your other pans by how closely they match, and tells you how much to scale the recipe to fit

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No login, no internet connection, no ads. Every recipe you save stays on your device. Set your preferred units once and start cooking.

- Instant Servings Scaler: Scale recipes up or down (0.5x, 2x, 3x) with accurate decimal adjustments
- Reverse Ingredient Scaling: Enter the amount of your key ingredient to automatically resize the entire recipe

description:

Save a recipe once and rescale its ingredient amounts whenever your plans change. Scale by servings, pieces, slices, or finished weight; choose an ingredient and enter the amount you currently have; or adjust a recipe for round, square, and rectangular pans. The app shows the calculated multiplier together with the original and updated quantities so changes remain easy to review.

Common kitchen measurements are formatted in practical increments, while supported metric and US units can be converted across a recipe. Weight and volume conversions use stored ingredient-density information where applicable.

Recipe Scale also includes tools for estimating ingredient costs and cost per serving, working with baker's percentages, adjusting dough hydration, and following a recipe in a step-by-step cooking view. Multiple timers can be used during preparation, and the screen can remain awake while Cooking Mode is active.

Recipes can also be added from pasted text and edited afterward. A built-in unit converter supports common cooking measurements and temperatures, including Celsius, Fahrenheit, and gas marks. Ingredients from one or several recipes can be combined into a shopping list to make preparation easier.

Recipe calculations are intended as practical cooking aids. Weight-to-volume conversions can vary between ingredients and products, and pan-size or baking-time guidance should be treated as a reference rather than a guarantee.

Made for home cooks, caterers, canteens, parties, weddings, temple and church kitchens, and anyone cooking for a crowd.

MAKE A FOOD
• Give it a name and say how many people it feeds
• Add each item with its quantity
• Choose the unit: nos, piece, dozen, packet, can, bunch, clove, teaspoon, tablespoon, cup, glass, gram, kilogram, millilitre, litre, ounce, pound, pinch, handful and more

SAY HOW MANY PEOPLE

AMOUNTS THAT MAKE SENSE
• Onions and eggs round up to whole ones, because nobody buys part of an onion
• Units tidy themselves: 1500 g becomes 1.5 kg, 3 teaspoons become 1 tablespoon
• Each line shows what it was before
• Switch cups to grams and millilitres

KEEP YOUR FOODS

description:

SCALE ANY RECIPE

CONVERT THAT UNDERSTANDS INGREDIENTS
- Switch a whole recipe to US or metric with one tap, or keep it as written

KITCHEN-FRIENDLY ROUNDING

PASTE A WHOLE RECIPE

- Quick unit converter for cups, spoons, millilitres, grams, ounces and pounds

name: Dotgrid — Bullet Journal
description:
Dotgrid is a bullet journal for Android: a daily log, task list, notes and calendar in one quiet notebook. It is completely free, and it will stay free forever: no ads, no premium tier, no subscription, no account, and it works fully offline.

Most to-do list and planner apps roll your unfinished tasks forward for you, and the list only grows. Dotgrid does the opposite. Nothing moves on its own. When a task goes unfinished, you decide, one item at a time: move it to today, schedule it for later, or strike it out. This is bullet journal migration, the method that makes a bullet journal work, and Dotgrid keeps the friction on purpose.

A day with Dotgrid
— Morning: open the journal and see today. Your tasks, notes and events sit in one list, with your phone's calendars alongside, read-only.
— During the day: type "call the dentist 3pm" and press Done. It is filed with a time, and a reminder if you want one. A dash starts a note, an o starts an event, * marks a priority.
— Evening: the daily sweep shows what is left. Push a task to tomorrow, put it in next week or next month, or cross it off. Plain counts, never percentages.
— End of month: the monthly review lists what is still open, so nothing quietly follows you around for weeks.

What's inside
— One line to capture anything, plus a form for when you would rather tap
— Day, Week, Month and Year views behind one sidebar, and a Future log for things that are not dated yet
— Habits you count each day, in times or minutes, toward a goal or under a limit, with a streak and a year of days at a glance
— Saved filters, an Archive for anything you put away, and a Trash to restore what you deleted
— Tasks, subtasks, notes and events; repeating tasks; reminders that name the entry
— Collections, tags and links between entries, so a task can sit on its day and in a project
— Drag to reorder a day, or to move an entry to another day; swipe for Done, Strike out, Today or Later
— Search across everything; a calendar to jump to any day, week, month or year; a daily nudge if you want one
— Home screen widgets that resize to any shape; long-press the icon to add a task, note or event
— Share into Dotgrid from any app; export as readable Markdown, or the whole journal as one file
— A short guided first run, and a guide on every page

Private by design
Your journal lives on your phone, in a database only Dotgrid can read. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you connect a backup yourself: a folder you choose, or your own Dropbox or Google Drive account. Cloud backups are plain copies in your own account, in a folder only Dotgrid uses, so they are as private as that account. No analytics, no tracking, no sign-in. Restore only when you ask; never automatic sync.

Black and white on dot-grid paper, on purpose. Colour appears in exactly two places, a collection or tag's dot and a calendar's dot. Light and dark themes, large text and TalkBack are supported throughout.

Dotgrid is small and stays that way. If a feature would turn the notebook into a dashboard, it is not in this app.

name: Ink: Daily Journaling Prompts
description:

Not sure how to start journaling – or struggling with consistency? Try Ink!

With a clear daily journaling structure, 1,000+ journal prompts and over 60 unique guided sessions, Ink gives you the nudge and accountability to finally stick your journaling habit.

FIND SOMETHING TO WRITE ABOUT

Explore prompts about emotions, relationships, gratitude, boundaries, self-trust, identity, goals, meaning, and everyday life. Choose daily journal prompts for a quick check-in, or follow a question into a longer reflection.

Ink is a prompted journal with practical journaling ideas for different moods, moments, and schedules. Its journaling prompts remove the pressure of facing a blank page while leaving you free to decide how much to write.

CHOOSE HOW YOU WANT TO JOURNAL

You can add journal entries in 3 ways with Ink:

1. WRITE BY HAND: Open a prompt and start the session timer, then put your phone aside and write in your own paper notebook.
2. TYPE IN INK: Write a free entry or respond directly to a prompt in the app.
3. SPEAK YOUR THOUGHTS: Record your response and use audio transcription to turn it into a written entry.

Ink works perfectly alongside a paper notebook or as a writing journal on your phone, so you can use the method that fits your day.

GO DEEPER WITH GUIDED JOURNALING

Choose from 60+ multi-step sessions and multi-day journeys when one question is not enough. Each guided journal session leads you through related questions so you can examine a theme from different angles.

Practice useful journaling techniques through morning and evening reflections, weekly reviews, and sessions about emotional clarity, relationships, boundaries, strengths, gratitude, mistakes, support, work, and purpose.

BUILD A DAILY JOURNALING ROUTINE

Set reminders to make time for reflection. Use the calendar to see which days you journaled, track your mood, save a highlight, or add a photo that helps you remember the session.

Browse, search, favorite, edit, and delete past entries whenever you want to revisit them. Use Ink as a simple daily journal, a journal with prompts, or a structured space for deeper reflection.

YOUR ENTRIES STAY ON YOUR DEVICE BY DEFAULT

Your journal content is stored locally on your device by default. Optionally, you can activate the back up feature to save your content to the cloud and access it on other devices, or if your app is deleted.

With Ink, you can:
• Explore nearly 1,000 unique prompts

• Set a timer and daily reminders
• Track moods, save highlights, and add photos

• Keep content local or enable optional cloud backup

Start your daily journaling habit with Ink today!

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS

Ink offers monthly and annual subscriptions, as well as lifetime access.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Google Play account.

name: Prompted Journal - Shadow Work
description:
Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.
- A five minute habit: one daily question, one honest answer.
- "Dive Deeper" follow-up questions on every prompt, for the days you want to keep going.
- Write your own prompts and keep them alongside the catalog.
- A private diary with a biometric lock. Your writing stays yours.
- Daily reminders that keep the habit going.
- A free quote of the day to open each entry.
- Use it as a gratitude journal, a mood diary, a dream diary or a guided journal — whatever your daily writing practice needs.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

Download Prompted and start today — a private diary with guided prompts for reflection, shadow work and growth.

name: Daily Rituals: Journal Prompts

• Write on the paper you like: lined, dotted, grid, kraft and more.

• Insights in plain sentences: how you felt, the hours you write, your weekly rhythm.
• A keepsake poster of your year, saved to your gallery or shared.

description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily gratitude diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

A JOURNAL APP THAT ASKS FOR LESS

Most journal apps hand you a blank page and a cursor. This one asks the same question every evening, so a diary entry is finished in the time it takes to make tea. If you have looked for a free journal app, a gratitude diary or a daily writing habit and bounced off the effort, that is the gap this gratitude app is built for.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this one only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology as a gratitude exercise, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening, in the ordinary mood you happen to be in.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily gratitude diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Calluna: Gratitude Journal
developer: La Boîte à Rêves - The Dream Box - Bedtime stories
description:
An annoyance stays with you all day. A small good thing fades in ten minutes. Calluna exists to correct that imbalance.

Every evening, you write down three good things from your day. Even tiny ones. Even "silly" ones. Two minutes, no more. It's the Three Good Things exercise from psychologist Martin Seligman, one of the most studied in positive psychology — and the heart of your gratitude journal.

Except here, your good things don't pile up in a list you never reopen. Each one opens a flower, and your plant for the month grows with you: seed, sprout, young plant, flowering shrub, majestic tree. On the last day of the month it joins your garden for good. Twelve months, twelve plants, a whole year you can take in at a glance.

It's a gratitude journal you can watch grow. That's why the habit sticks — and why Calluna works as a self-care diary rather than one more app you forget.


🌱 YOUR EVENING RITUAL

• Three good things, in two minutes flat
• Your mood for the day, in a single tap
• Voice dictation for the evenings you'd rather not type
• "Thanks to what, or to whom?" — the why, if you feel like it
• A gentle daily reminder, at the time and on the days you choose
• Missed yesterday? You can still go back


🌸 YOUR PLANT, YOUR GARDEN

• Every gratitude you note opens a flower
• Your plant moves through five growth stages each month
• A small celebration when it joins your garden
• Your year at a glance: flowers opened, plants grown, days in bloom
• Give each of your plants a name


💐 THE DAYS WHEN IT ISN'T GOING WELL

This is where a positive journal actually earns its place.

• Support mode offers you a good memory when the day is rough
• The happiness bank: draw a random moment from everything you've kept
• Anniversaries: what you were living a week, a month, a year ago
• The Sunday bouquet: your week gathered into flowers


📅 WHAT YOU END UP LEARNING ABOUT YOURSELF

• Daily mood tracking: your whole month, day by day, in colour
• Your sources of happiness: twelve categories, from nature to the smallest treat
• The people who come up most often in your good things
• And sometimes the urge to thank them — Calluna helps you find the words


🤍 WHO IT'S FOR

• Anyone who wants a daily gratitude habit without spending their evenings on it
• Anyone who has opened a diary before and given up after a week
• Anyone who needs to see progress — that's what the plant is for
• Anyone looking for gentle mood tracking, with no scoring and no judgement
• Anyone building a self-care routine that survives a busy week
• Anyone who wants to look after their mental wellbeing two minutes at a time


🔒 YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS

It's a private journal. We built it like one.

• Your journal is stored on your phone. We don't read it: we don't have it.
• No account, no sign-up. No email, no password. You open it and you write.
• It works offline, on the train as easily as at the bottom of the garden.
• Back up to YOUR OWN Google Drive, or export to a file. Whenever you like.
• Fingerprint lock, if you prefer.
• No ads. No data resold. Your good things are of no interest to anyone but you.


🎁 FREE, GENUINELY

No subscription, no in-app purchases, no version that locks after seven days. The whole journal, all the time.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.


Calluna is the Latin name for heather: the flower that opens at the end of the season, on the poorest soils, where almost nothing else grows.

There is always something worth picking.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.
