name: Mood Patterns: Mood Tracker
description:
Mood Patterns: Advanced Offline Mood Tracker, Journal & Data Analytics

Please Note Before Downloading:
Mood Patterns is not a simple “tap a smiley face” diary. It is an advanced, 100% offline mood tracker and analytics tool built for data-driven individuals who want to uncover real statistical correlations in their daily habits and emotional well-being. Because it uses Ecological Momentary Assessment (experience sampling) and continuous bipolar scales, there is a brief learning curve. If you want a basic journal, this app is not for you. If you want a rigorous tool to understand your emotional patterns with total privacy, keep reading.

No Forced Subscriptions. 100% Local Privacy.
Your mood and health data are intensely personal. Mood Patterns is built on a strict privacy-first architecture:
• Zero Internet Access: The app does not request or have internet permissions. No background uploads, no cloud sync, no ads, and no tracking.
• 100% Local Storage: Your data never leaves your device.
• Encrypted & Locked: All data is protected by 256-bit AES encryption (SQLCipher) and secured with an optional PIN or biometric app lock (fingerprint).

Transparent Pricing: Free to Use, Pay to Upgrade
We believe you should own your tools. Core experience sampling and mood tracking features are completely free to use. For those who want to unlock advanced analytics and unlimited custom scales, we offer a transparent Pro upgrade: choose between a low-cost monthly subscription or a 1-time Lifetime Unlock. You will never be forced into a perpetual subscription just to access your own data.

Experience Sampling (Ecological Momentary Assessment)
Classical end-of-day diaries suffer from recall bias—we mostly remember peak or extreme moments. Mood Patterns uses experience sampling (a method from psychological research) to prompt you at random or fixed intervals throughout the day, capturing your authentic emotional baseline and how everyday routines truly affect you.

Granular Customization for Data Enthusiasts
Don't settle for fixed categories. Your life is unique, and your tracking parameters should be too:
• Track context across people, places (with optional GPS), primary and secondary activities, factors, sleep (manual or via Health Connect), phone/app usage, photos, events, and multi-day periods.
• Use 30 predefined bipolar mood scales or create up to 50 fully custom, user-defined scales.
• Set custom alerts for emotional thresholds and schedule personal affirmations.
• Add Markdown-formatted notes and photos to your surveys for rich journaling context.

Deep Analytics, PDF Reports & CSV Export
Turn your daily habits into actionable insights:
• Explore your data through interactive, zoomable time-series charts, weekday & time-of-day profiles, and before/after event comparisons.
• Discover statistical correlations and rankings between your feelings, sleep, screen time, and external factors.
• Generate structured Weekly and Episode PDF reports, or export raw CSV data optimized for spreadsheets (Excel, R, Python) so you or your therapist can run in-depth multivariable analyses.

Take control of your data. Discover your patterns.

- DBT diary card prompts across distress tolerance, emotion regulation, interpersonal effectiveness, and mindfulness

- Grounding exercises for ruminative loops and intrusive thoughts

🛡️ PRIVACY AND SECURITY

name: Shared Khata: Split Bill & IOU
description:
Shared Khata is a shared expense tracker for friends, roommates and small groups. Split bills, track IOUs and see who owes who in one ledger that everyone in it can see and edit. Entries sync to every phone, and the app works offline too.

Keep a ledger with one person, or start a group of up to 6 people for a flat, a trip or your family. A simple bill splitter and expense splitter for everyday life: split expenses with friends and always know who owes you money.

No more "I already paid you" arguments. Everyone adds entries to the same ledger, and everyone sees the same balance.

How it works
1. Create a ledger with one person or a group, then share the invite link
2. Anyone in the ledger adds a bill or a payment
3. Every phone shows the same balance, until it says Settled

Split bills with a group
- Start a group of up to 6 people: roommates, a trip, family or colleagues
- Split a bill equally, by exact amounts or by percent, and pick who was part of it
- See each member's balance: who should receive and who should pay
- Settle up: record a payment in a tap, or just part of it
- Spending summary: total spent, your share, who paid and where the money went
- One invite link for the whole group. Each person picks their own name to join

Ledgers with one person
- A shared ledger with a roommate, partner, friend, sibling or colleague
- Add an entry as You Gave or You Got in a few taps
- Split a bill equally, or record the full amount

In every ledger
- Pick a category: Food, Groceries, Rent, Utilities, Transport, Shopping, Entertainment, Medicine or Other. The app remembers the ones you use
- Add a title, a date and an optional note
- See who owes who at a glance: You Will Receive or You Will Pay
- See "Settled" when you are even
- Search your ledgers by name

Everyone sees the same ledger
- Changes sync as soon as you're online, and the others see them when they open the ledger
- Get notified when someone adds, edits or deletes an entry, so nothing changes quietly
- Only the person who added an entry, or the ledger owner, can edit or delete it
- Add people by phone number, email or from your contacts, then share the invite link on WhatsApp or any app

Works offline
- Add entries with no internet, on a flight or with weak signal
- Shared Khata syncs on its own when you are back online

Any currency, anywhere
- Use any currency. Your local currency is picked for you
- Available in multiple languages. Switch the language anytime in Settings
- Light, dark or system theme
- Sign in with your phone number or Google account
- Delete your account from inside the app at any time
- Free to use, with no ads and no daily entry limits

Great for
- Roommates: a roommate expense tracker for rent, groceries and utility bills
- A trip with friends: split the hotel, fuel and meals
- Couples tracking shared expenses
- Family and siblings sharing home costs
- Money owed between friends
- Lunch and coffee with colleagues
- A simple debt tracker everyone agrees on

What does "khata" mean?
Khata means "ledger" in Urdu and Hindi. In Pakistan and India, Shared Khata is your personal khata or hisab kitab: an udhar hisab you keep with friends and family, not a tool for shops. Everywhere else, think of it as a shared IOU tracker for split bills and money owed.

Shared Khata: split bills with friends and groups, track IOUs and always know who owes who.

name: Menu cost calculator
description:
This calculator is developed for for financially literate people who verify receipts and invoices issued by restaurants.

It's no secret that you can get cheated in a restaurant and pay a little more than you need to. To prevent this, this calculator has been created.

Suitable for a large company and banquets, when you need to quickly calculate the cost of all dishes.

The menu calculator will allow you to quickly check the restaurant bill against a pre-entered list of dishes(food)

Imagine a situation, you go to the same place for lunch every day and order about the same meals.

Your restaurant has a permanent list of business lunch menus.
After lunch you pay at the restaurant.

To check the cost of your lunch, simply add all the restaurant's dishes to our app.

This can be done on the 👉Food tab via the menu.

When visiting a restaurant, add the dishes you ordered to the calculator from the 👉Food screen. You can do this by clicking the add button near the name.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and select them using the checkbox to the right of each dish or by pressing.

The app will calculate the total cost of your lunch.

Before going to the restaurant

You should start working with the application from the restaurants tab.
Add all the places where you go to eat on this tab.

Next, go to the 👉 Food tab and select add from the menu.

Add all the dishes you would normally order for each of your restaurants. Specify the price of each dish and select a restaurant when adding.

It is better to take a picture of the restaurant menu before going to it and add the main dishes that you plan or already order often.


How to use app in a restaurant?
After lunch, add all the dishes you ordered through the 👉 Food tab. Click add next to each dish.

You can change a restaurant in the drop-down list of dishes at the top of the list of dishes. All dishes of the selected restaurant will be shown.

Another alternative option for filling out the list for calculating the cost is to go to the Restaurants tab and by long-clicking on the selected restaurant select 👉Load menu.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and mark the dishes you want.
The price of all dishes will be calculated at the top next to the For pay label.

If suddenly you need to find out the price for half a portion, then by long pressing in the calculator menu, select 👉Half portion. The price of the selected dish will be halved.

If you ordered a new dish that is not in your calculation list, select Add dish from the menu and set the dish name and price.

The dish will be included in the calculation immediately
How to delete dishes from calculation
With a long press on each dish, a menu appears. Select 👉Delete from the menu and the selected dish will be removed from the list. To delete all dishes from the calculator - select 👉Clear

Deleting a dish in the calculator does not delete it from the application. It remains in the list of all dishes.

Finally, delete the dish through the menu by long pressing on the dish on the 👉Food tab.

description:

Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

name: Loop Habit Tracker
description:
Loop helps you create and maintain good habits, allowing you to achieve your long-term goals. Detailed charts and statistics show you how your habits improved over time. The app is completely ad-free, open source and it respects your privacy.


Simple, beautiful and modern interface
Loop has a minimalistic interface that is very easy to use and follows the material design guidelines.

Habit score
In addition to showing your current streak, Loop has an advanced formula for calculating the strength of your habits. Every repetition makes your habit stronger, and every missed day makes it weaker. A few missed days after a long streak, however, will not completely destroy your entire progress, unlike other don't-break-the-chain apps.

Detailed graphs and statistics
Clearly see how your habits improved over time with detailed charts and statistics. Scroll back to see the complete history of your habits.

Flexible schedules
Supports not only daily habits, but also habits with more complex schedules, such as 3 times every week; one time every other week; or every other day.

Reminders
Create an individual reminder for each habit, at a chosen hour of the day. Easily check, dismiss or snooze your habit directly from the notification, without opening the app.

Widgets
Track your habits directly from your home screen, with beautiful and colorful widgets.

Completely ad-free and open source
There are absolutely no advertisements, annoying notifications or intrusive permissions in this app, and there will never be. The complete source code is available under an open-source license (GPLv3).

Works offline and respects your privacy
Loop doesn't require an Internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential habit data never leaves your phone. Neither the developers nor any third-parties have access to it.

Take your data with you
If you want to further analyze your data or move it to another service, Loop allows you to export it to spreadsheets (CSV) or to a database format (SQLite).

Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.

Want to go for a nice walk every day? Or maybe give 3 hugs every Saturday and Sunday? Join us on this journey!

» Who is it for?
Whether you want to read some more, stop smoking, start working out or even just track how many hours you wasted on Facebook, this app lets you do it!

» Features
•  Track multiple habits, repeated to do's or goals, each in its own calendar
•  Streak counter and percentage successful for each habit
•  Yes/No or Number goals
•  Very flexible goals like: number of times per day/week/month, only on certain days of the week etc. For example: 30 push ups every Mon-Fri, go to the gym 2 times per week, or even every 2 days
•  Inspiring quotes per category - including actual quotes from people doing it (meditation, reading, stop drinking alcohol, stop smoking cigarettes, stop procrastination etc)
•  Graphs with success percentage / streak, entered values etc
•  Powerful reminders - multiple times per day, repeating within a time period, sound and vibrate optional
•  Home screen / lock screen widget
•  Multi-device syncing
•  Cloud backup
•  Motivational images
•  Export to CSV
•  Dark theme
•  Google Fit integration

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

- Primary warranty from the manufacturer
- Extended warranties purchased separately
- Store guarantees from the retailer

- Personal Items: Watches, furniture, tools, and high-value purchases

No cloud. No tracking. No nonsense.

DEDUCTIBLE EXPENSES
Scan a receipt: the app reads the amount, the date and the shop, and suggests a category — medical, veterinary, school, university, children's sport, mortgage interest, funeral costs and more.

Every field the camera read stays editable, and the app always shows you where a number came from. Correct it and it stops being the app's reading and becomes yours.

It also flags an expense paid in cash: many Italian deductions require a traceable payment, and that is what most often costs people the deduction at the end of the year.

In December you build the folder: one PDF with every receipt of the year, sorted by category, ready to hand to your accountant.

WHAT THE APP DOES NOT DO
Vault Fiscale does not work out your taxes. It does not fill in your tax return, it does not tell you what you will get back, and it files nothing with any authority. Rates, thresholds and ceilings change every year and depend on your own situation — check those with whoever prepares your return. The app keeps the paperwork in order, readable and findable.

WARRANTIES
Anything you buy can carry its receipt, its warranty, its serial number, its manuals, its repairs and its servicing. One place, for the whole life of the object.

Returns and warranties stay separate, because they are separate: a return window closes in days, a warranty lasts years. Blurring them is the fastest way to lose the one that expires first.

Reminders arrive before a deadline, not the day after. And the widget keeps the next deadline and the year's total on your Home screen.

WARRANTY FOLDER
When something breaks, one tap gathers the receipt, the warranty, the serial number and the documents into a single PDF, ready to show the shop or the service centre.

FROM OTHER APPS
A PDF in Gmail, a photo, a file in Files: Share › Vault Fiscale, and it opens already read, ready to save as a receipt, a product or a document.

PRIVACY
No account. No server of ours. Everything you scan stays on your phone. No advertising, no analytics, no tracking. Text recognition runs on the phone with Google's ML Kit: no image is uploaded anywhere. If you like, the app opens only with your passcode or your fingerprint.

FREE AND PRO
Free, forever, with no time limit: unlimited tax receipts, the scanner, the categories, the traceable-payment check, reminders, and up to 5 products with 3 documents each.

Pro unlocks:
• The yearly tax folder as a PDF, ready for your accountant
• Unlimited products and unlimited documents

• Advanced search and filters

Pro is a one-time purchase, or an optional yearly subscription. The one-time purchase does not expire and does not renew.

name: Hvacio: Serwis HVAC, Przeglądy
description:
Hvacio to mobilna aplikacja dla niezależnych serwisantów branży HVAC w Polsce. Pozwala prowadzić bazę klientów, rejestr urządzeń i historię wizyt serwisowych bezpośrednio z telefonu, także bez dostępu do internetu w terenie. Po zakończonej wizycie automatycznie generujesz protokół serwisowy w formacie PDF i wysyłasz go do klienta jednym kliknięciem.

Aplikacja jest narzędziem profesjonalnym, zaprojektowanym dla osób obsługujących kotły gazowe i urządzenia objęte dozorem UDT, klimatyzacje typu split, multisplit i VRF, pompy ciepła powietrze-woda oraz gruntowe, rekuperatory i wentylację mechaniczną. Sprawdzi się też w serwisie innych urządzeń HVAC, ponieważ formularz wizyty pozwala dostosować listę czynności do typu obsługiwanego sprzętu.

W aplikacji prowadzisz bazę klientów wraz z pełnymi danymi kontaktowymi, adresem i numerami identyfikacyjnymi firmy. Dla klientów biznesowych dane firmy można pobrać automatycznie z rejestru REGON Głównego Urzędu Statystycznego po podaniu NIP, bez ręcznego przepisywania. Bazę można też zaimportować z pliku Excel, jeśli prowadziłeś ją wcześniej w arkuszu.

Do każdego klienta przypisujesz urządzenia, które serwisujesz, wraz z numerami seryjnymi i historią przeglądów. Podczas wizyty wybierasz urządzenie, zaznaczasz wykonane czynności z listy dopasowanej do jego typu i opisujesz zużyte materiały. Wszystko zapisuje się od razu w pamięci telefonu, a po powrocie w zasięg sieci synchronizuje się z chmurą.

Każdej wizycie możesz dorzucić zdjęcia urządzenia robione prosto z aplikacji oraz notatki głosowe nagrywane w terenie. Notatki głosowe pozwalają udokumentować szczegóły obsługi szybciej, niż pisanie palcem na ekranie podczas pracy w kotłowni czy na dachu.

Po zakończeniu wizyty aplikacja generuje protokół serwisowy w PDF, zawierający dane firmy, listę wykonanych czynności, użyte materiały i datę przeglądu. Protokół wysyłasz klientowi e-mailem prosto z aplikacji. W stopce możesz dorzucić link do formularza opinii Google Maps, który pomaga budować pozytywne oceny firmy w wyszukiwarce.

Każdy serwisant otrzymuje publiczną mini-stronę pod adresem hvacio.pl, na której prezentowane są dane kontaktowe i lista obsługiwanych typów urządzeń. Strona ma uporządkowane meta-dane dla wyszukiwarek, dzięki czemu klienci szukający lokalnego serwisu mogą cię znaleźć w Google.

Powiadomienia push przypominają o nadchodzących przeglądach, dzięki czemu nie tracisz zlecenia z powodu zapomnianej daty.

Wszystkie dane synchronizują się przez bezpieczne połączenie HTTPS. Zdjęcia i nagrania głosowe trzymamy w europejskim regionie chmury, we Frankfurcie. Subskrypcję obsługujemy na stronie hvacio.pl, w aplikacji nie ma żadnych płatności wewnętrznych.

Procedura usunięcia konta i wszystkich powiązanych danych dostępna jest pod adresem hvacio.pl/usun-konto. Pomoc techniczna oraz pytania o prywatność: support@hvacio.pl.

Do you struggle with staying motivated when you commit to doing something valuable in the long run, like learning new words, practicing an instrument, working out, or mastering a new language? Initially, you're full of enthusiasm, but soon, your passion wanes. Memorizing words becomes a chore, the instrument is neglected, workouts turn into a burden, and progress in the new language stalls...
You start doubting yourself: “Maybe I just don’t have what it takes to stick with long-term commitments.”

That’s not true! Let us explain the real reasons.

● Lack of Immediate Rewards:
You understand the long-term value of these tasks, but how much does this half-hour of focus matter right now?

● Repetition Leads to Boredom:
When the initial novelty wears off, the repetitive nature of the task can make you feel bored and tired.

● Overly Negative Focus:
Focusing on what you haven't accomplished rather than acknowledging what you have done can lead to negative self-evaluation and loss of motivation.

Let Exocus Help You!


====== Exocus Solutions ======

Exocus is a gamified focus timer that visualizes your concentration as a planet's evolution, helping you achieve long-term, pain-free focus.

● Emotional Design and Sense of Meaning
After each focus session, you’ll see the story of what happened to your planet during that time. Even five minutes of focus equals 38.53 million years of evolution for your planet, so your focus is crucial. Want to raise the stakes? You can enable “Hardcore Mode,” where failing to focus might cause your planet to be destroyed!

● Stage-Based Incentives
Short-term Incentives: After each focus session, the planet’s landscape changes and tells you its story.
Medium-term Incentives: After several hours of focus, the planet undergoes more significant transformations, like forming magma, oceans, and land.
Long-term Incentives: After around ten hours of focus, the planet completes its evolution. You can then add it to your star system, with each project corresponding to a star system, showcasing your long-term accumulation in that project.

● Continuous Freshness
We offer hundreds of unique planet designs, satisfying your curiosity and desire to collect with constant surprises. See a planet's full appearance only after evolving it through focused efforts. Earn Stardust coins by focusing to unlock new planet seeds, motivating continuous concentration.


====== What Makes Exocus Special? ======

● Meticulously Crafted Design
Exocus uses a unique pixel art style, maintaining simplicity while incorporating delightful little Easter eggs for you to discover. We believe the beauty of Exocus can bring joy, which will ultimately translate into more focused time.

● Fun Game Elements
Exocus embraces gamified design in a bold yet restrained and professional manner. We hope the game elements help you enjoy focusing, and we also care deeply about your ability to truly focus. We’ve eliminated anything that could distract you because we genuinely want to focus on achieving long-term goals with you.

● Flexible Focus Modes
Exocus supports countdown timers, stopwatch mode, and the Pomodoro technique. In the Pomodoro technique, you can flexibly set focus and break durations and specify longer breaks after several focus cycles.

● Convenient Project Management
Each project corresponds to a planet. You can track different categories of focus time with projects and quickly switch between projects on the home screen by swiping left or right.

● Personalized Statistics
Based on your focus data, we provide personalized charts to help you understand your focus patterns and stay motivated to maintain consistent focus.

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.


Daily goal setting, minimalistic design beautiful color themes, notifications and more.

name: Wimmo — ADHD Body Doubling
description:
Wimmo is a quiet focus companion for starting the thing you've been putting off. One thing at a time.

Body doubling usually means working with another person in the room. Wimmo is not a person. There is no video, no camera and nobody watching. The app itself keeps you company: the sound of light rain, a circle that empties as the time goes, and a few short check-ins that use your own words.

HOW IT WORKS

• Type what you're putting off, in your own words. However badly.
• If the task is vague, Wimmo may ask up to two short questions. Then it gives the task back as a few small steps.
• Start the session. The clock, the sound and the circle start together. Choose 10, 25, 45 or 60 minutes.
• You see one step at a time. Tap Done or Skip when you're ready, or open the whole plan when you want to see it.
• A few times in a session, Wimmo asks how it's going. Write a reply if you like, or ignore it and it fades.
• At the end, it shows what you said and asks: Did you do it? Yes, Half or No. Every answer is treated the same.

ALSO IN WIMMO

• Smaller steps. When a step still feels too big, ask for a smaller one.
• Clear your head. Write down everything on your mind. Wimmo sorts it into tasks you can change, then save to Home.
• Your tasks. Mark a task Done or Half, leave a note on what's left, and pick it up next time.
• Break timer. Set any length from 1 minute to 12 hours. When the time is up, an alarm rings and suggests a short break: a walk, some water, a stretch.
• Sessions. A plain record of what you worked on and how long you sat with it. No scores, no ranking, nothing that counts days in a row.

YOUR ACCOUNT AND YOUR DATA

• Your first session needs no account. To keep going after that, sign in with Google.
• Sessions and the break timer run without a connection. Planning steps, Smaller steps and Clear your head need the internet.
• Delete your history or your whole account from inside the app, at any time.

Wimmo is a productivity app. It is not a medical product.

name: Paulora: ADHD Body Double
description:
Starting is the hard part. Paulora sits with you while you do it.

A body double is someone who works alongside you so that you actually begin. It is one of the few things that reliably helps an ADHD brain start - and it normally means booking a stranger, or asking a friend at nine on a Tuesday night.

Paulora is a voice body double. Always there, nothing to schedule, nobody watching you.

Tell her the thing you have been putting off - typed or spoken - and she breaks it into steps small enough that the first one takes under a minute. Then she stays. Out loud. While you do it.

Not another planner. Planners hand you a tidy list and walk away. Paulora stays.


SHE IS A VOICE, NOT A NOTIFICATION

She reads the step aloud, so you do not have to look at the screen to know what you are doing. She checks in while you work - not to chase you, just so the room is not empty. Talk back whenever you like and she answers. When you finish, she says so, out loud.

That presence is the whole product. Everything else is in service of it.


HOW IT WORKS

1. Say it or type it
Describe what you are avoiding, in your own words. No categories, no tags, no setup.

2. Get a first step you can start now
Three to six micro-steps. If the first one still feels too big, tap "First step too big" and she splits it again - mid-session, as many times as you need.

3. Start, with company
A sitting is five minutes - a focus timer with company. She reads the step, stays with you while you work, and counts it done when you say so.


WHAT IS IN IT

- Voice in, voice out - speak your task, talk back mid-session, or run the whole thing in text. Quiet mode turns every spoken line into on-screen text.

- "First step too big" - one tap splits a step into smaller pieces, without leaving the session.

- The two-minute deal - when you are ready to quit, she offers a deal: two more minutes, then you are free to stop. Most people do not.

- A reality check on time - guess how long it will take before you start. Afterwards she tells you what it actually took. The gap is usually the point.

- A parking lot - say "remind me to call the bank" mid-session and the thought is set aside instead of derailing you. She brings it back when you are done.

- Your done pile - a calendar of what you finished and how long each one took, kept on your device.

- No streaks to break. Disappear for nine days and come back to "good to see you", not a guilt screen. Nothing to lose by being away.


PAULORA PLUS

Free gives you five sessions a day, spoken in your phone's own voice.

Plus gives you Paulora's voice - the real one - on every session, with no daily limit. It also unlocks two more characters to work alongside: Hype, who is loud and firmly on your side, and Snark, who is dry about the whole business. Four further voices and a daytime look come with it.

Her voice costs real money every time she speaks. That is why the free tier uses your phone's, and why this is not a ninety-nine pence app.


NO ACCOUNT, NO SIGN-UP, NO ADS

There is nothing to log in to. Open the app and start. Your tasks, your name and your history stay in your device's storage - there is no account to sync them to. Paulora never records or stores your audio. Speech recognition is handled by Android's own recogniser - depending on your device and which language packs it has, Android may do that on the device or on Google's servers. No ads, no ad ID, no analytics, no tracking.

An internet connection is needed for the step breakdown and for Paulora's voice.


WHO IT IS FOR

Built for ADHD brains - procrastination, task paralysis, executive dysfunction, the overwhelm of a list you cannot start - and for anyone whose to-do list is a graveyard. The problem was never the plan, it was the starting.

Paulora is a productivity tool, not a medical one. It does not diagnose, treat or manage any condition and is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling, an ADHD-informed clinician is worth the wait.

name: Battery Watch: Battery Monitor
description:
Battery Watch is a battery monitoring app for Android. View battery level, temperature, current and voltage, explore recorded charging and discharging sessions, and follow screen-on and screen-off usage over time. Use recorded data to understand battery habits.

LIVE BATTERY READINGS
See the readings your phone makes available, including battery percentage, temperature in degrees Celsius, current in mA and voltage in V. Power in W is calculated from the reported battery current and voltage. It describes power at the battery, rather than a direct measurement of your charger's output. Open a metric to view its recorded trend.

CHARGING AND DISCHARGING HISTORY
Review saved sessions with their duration, starting and ending battery levels, and available average current, voltage and temperature readings. Browse charging and discharging separately. Session charts show changes during a charge or a period of battery use. Records begin when tracking runs; the app cannot recover battery samples it never recorded.

SCREEN AND SLEEP INSIGHTS
Explore recorded screen-on time, screen-off time, deep-sleep duration and Android Doze intervals. Where charge-counter readings are available, see estimated battery drain during recorded screen-on and screen-off periods. These summaries describe observed device activity; they do not identify every cause of battery drain.

Optional Usage Access adds historical screen events and foreground app-usage information. Per-app drain figures, when shown, allocate observed drain using foreground activity time. They are estimates, not direct measurements of each app's energy consumption. Missing events or monitoring gaps can leave parts of a period unaccounted for.

BATTERY AND TEMPERATURE REMINDERS
Turn battery-level and temperature reminders on or off, and receive a notification when a configured threshold is reached. Notifications must be allowed in Android settings. Reminders depend on fresh battery readings and may be delayed by background restrictions. Turning reminder switches on or off is free. Editing charge and temperature limits requires Pro or an eligible rewarded-ad unlock. A charge-level reminder does not stop charging.

CAPACITY, HEALTH AND CYCLES
View estimated remaining charge and design-capacity values where available. Battery health is an estimate derived from reported charge, battery percentage and design capacity, using qualifying charging observations when available. An initial reading may only support a preliminary approximation. These figures do not establish the battery's exact physical condition or remaining lifespan.

A device-reported cycle count is shown when Android or the device exposes an accessible counter. Otherwise, Battery Watch can estimate equivalent full discharge cycles from the battery use observed since tracking began. This estimate is not a recovered lifetime cycle count. Older Android versions and some newer devices may not supply a hardware count.

WIDGETS AND MONITORING OPTIONS
Add a battery-temperature widget for a quick view from your home screen. Choose light or dark appearance in the app and select a tracking level in Settings. Persistent monitoring uses an ongoing notification to help record activity while the app is in the background. Lighter tracking modes use fewer background mechanisms. Android and manufacturer restrictions can still interrupt collection, so history may contain gaps.

AVAILABILITY AND OPTIONAL UPGRADES
Battery Watch supports Android 9 and newer. Individual readings depend on the sensors, Android version and information exposed by your device. Battery conditions and reported values can change with charge level, temperature and phone activity; review several sessions for context.

The app is free to download and includes ads and in-app purchases. Pro unlocks additional features, including advanced statistics and eligible widget options. Some features offer temporary access through rewarded ads. See options and pricing in the app before purchase.

⚙️ HOW IT WORKS

Sectograph is lightweight, privacy-friendly, and works with your existing calendars on the device.
It overlays your day planner (routine, local calendar, Google Calendar) onto a clock-face timeline and automatically calculates:

• upcoming events
• time blocks and durations
• gaps between events and your real free time

Everything updates as time passes, keeping your schedule always current.
Not a to-do list — it’s a calendar-based schedule planner that visualizes what’s already on your calendar.


👀 HOW IT LOOKS

Like an analog clock your brain already understands — but with your day mapped onto it as sectors.

• Events appear exactly in the hours they happen (a radial / circular calendar view)
• Each sector width matches the event duration (a true pie-chart schedule)
• See gaps and the time from “now” to the next event at a glance

A clock planner / visual planner that helps you read your day instantly.


🎯 USE CASES & IDEAS

Use Sectograph as a day planner, daily planner, time planner, or routine planner for time management and daily schedule planning.
Great for time blocking (deep work, meetings, breaks), work/shift schedules, class schedules, travel itineraries, and Pomodoro planning (place focus sessions as time blocks).
If you like Chronodex, you’ll feel right at home.


🔄 SYNC & CALENDARS

Reads events from Google Calendar and your local device calendar; Microsoft Outlook calendar: beta.


📱 HOME SCREEN CALENDAR WIDGET

Keep your schedule always visible with a calendar widget / home screen widget.

• Automatic updates (including a clock refresh once a minute)
• Tap a sector to open details and quick actions
• Flexible visual settings + free widget themes: Dark / White / Gray
• Optional: light/dark app theme, 24-hour mode & extra zoom (1–12h), month/day grid views


⌚ WEAR OS (SMARTWATCH SUPPORT)

A true Wear OS calendar / smartwatch calendar at a glance:

• Watch app with an interactive widget
• Tile for quick access to the circular planner
• Watch face for continuous schedule awareness (installed separately)
• Large complication to enhance some third-party watch faces


🧠 HELPFUL FOR ADHD & “TIME BLINDNESS”

Designed to make time easier to grasp — especially if you struggle with time blindness, which is common for people with ADHD.
(Sectograph is not a medical app.)

✅ Install Sectograph and get a calm, visual overview of your day.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

• Tree nuts
• Soy
• Eggs
• Fish
• Shellfish

DIET CHECKER
• Vegan: spots products with animal ingredients
• Vegetarian: spots products that contain meat

• Watch sugar: warnings for high-sugar products
• Watch salt: warnings for salty products
• Heart health: warnings for saturated fat

When the product data is too thin to judge, SafeEat says "Incomplete data" instead of guessing. A clear "we don't know" is safer than a wrong "safe".

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account, no sign-up
• Your preferences and scan history are stored on your phone
• No ads

POWERED BY OPEN FOOD FACTS

• People with a food allergy or food intolerance: peanut allergy, tree nut allergy, milk, egg, soy, fish or shellfish

name: AllergenLens: Allergy Scanner
description:
AllergenLens reads the ingredient list on packaged food and highlights anything that matches the allergens and diets in your profile, including "may contain" warnings and less obvious names like whey, casein or tahini. Scanning happens on your phone, and your health details never leave it.

WHO IT'S FOR

YOUR PROFILE

• The rest of the EU's 14: cereals containing gluten, celery, mustard, lupin, molluscs and sulphites
• Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and lactose-free diets
• Add ingredients of your own
• Mark each one as an intolerance, an allergy or a severe allergy; the most serious matches are listed first

READS THE WHOLE LABEL
• Scan live with the camera, pick a photo, or type the text
• Finds the ingredient list and the "Contains" and "May contain" statements
• Reads labels in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch

KNOWS OTHER NAMES
• Derived ingredients count toward their allergen: whey, casein and ghee as milk; albumin as egg; semolina, spelt and couscous as wheat; marzipan and praline as tree nuts; arachis oil as peanut; tahini as sesame
• Ingredients and E-numbers with more than one possible source, like lecithin (E322), are marked to check

FOUR CLEAR ANSWERS
• Contains: something from your profile is in the ingredients or a "Contains" statement
• May contain: the label warns of possible cross-contact
• Not found in the text we read: no match, which isn't a guarantee
• Couldn't read clearly: part of the label was blurry, cut off or too small
Every flagged word is highlighted, and a coverage indicator shows how much of the label was read.

FREE, WITH NO SCAN LIMIT
Scanning and every warning are free: one profile, unlimited scans, all four answers, highlighted matches and the coverage indicator. No account and no ads.

ALLERGENLENS PLUS
Plus adds convenience, never protection:
• Up to 6 family profiles, with Whole family mode to check everyone at once
• Scan history with label photos, search, filters and saved products
• Travel allergy cards in 9 languages (English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean), full screen and offline, to show at a restaurant or shop
• Save travel cards as an image or PDF

• Yearly: $14.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial
• Monthly: $1.49 per month for the first 3 months, then $2.99 per month
• Lifetime: $29.99 once, with no renewal

Prices are in US dollars and vary by country; Google Play shows your price before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the full price unless cancelled before the current period ends. Cancel during the free trial and you won't be charged. Manage or cancel any time in Google Play under Payments & subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Profiles, label photos and results stay on your phone. There is no AllergenLens server.
• Your allergies and diets are never sent to analytics, advertisers or us
• Anonymous usage statistics can be turned off in Settings

PLEASE NOTE
AllergenLens helps you read labels. It is not medical advice and it can miss things: text can be misread, labels can be incomplete and recipes change. Always read the label on the package, ask the manufacturer when unsure, and if you have a severe allergy, follow your doctor's plan.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research

➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.

description:
Toxly is an ingredient scanner for food, cosmetics and household cleaning products. Point your camera at an ingredient list or scan a barcode, and Toxly tells you what each ingredient is, why it's there, and whether there's any reason to be concerned about it.

Ingredient labels are hard to read. Names like "sodium laureth sulfate", "E250" or "hydroxyacetophenone" mean little to most of us, and looking each one up in the middle of a shop isn't realistic. Toxly does that work for you in a few seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the ingredient list with your camera, or scan the product's barcode.
2. Toxly reads the label and checks every ingredient against scientific and regulatory sources.

WHAT YOU GET
• A clear safety grade. Every product is graded from A to F, and "Why this grade?" shows exactly which ingredients affected the score.
• A full ingredient breakdown. Each ingredient is explained in plain language: what it is, what it does in the product, and what the evidence says about it.
• Sources you can check. Ratings draw on public data such as PubChem hazard classifications, FDA and EU regulatory status, and the NOVA classification for processed foods.
• The amount matters. Where the label shows how much of an ingredient is used, the grade takes it into account, so a small amount of a preservative isn't treated the same as a main ingredient.
• AI deep dive. Tap any ingredient for a detailed analysis covering health concerns, regulatory status and a short summary.
• Right for the product type. A body lotion is assessed for skin contact, a snack for eating, and a cleaner for household use.
• Labels in many languages. Toxly reads multilingual labels and shows results in your language. The app is available in 17 languages.
• Your scan history. Every product you check is saved, with filters for food, personal care and cleaning.

USEFUL FOR
• Checking skincare, makeup and personal care products for ingredients you'd rather avoid, such as certain preservatives, sulfates or fragrance allergens.
• Comparing packaged foods for additives, E-numbers, sweeteners, colourings and how heavily processed they are.
• Parents choosing lotions, wipes, shampoos and snacks for their children.
• Understanding what's in the cleaning products you use at home.

PRIVACY
No account or sign-up needed. Your scan history is stored on your device.

TOXLY PREMIUM
Toxly is free to use, with a daily number of scans. Keeping up a scanning streak earns you extra ad-free scans. Toxly Premium removes ads and the daily limit, and adds nutrition information (calories, protein, carbs, sugars and fat) and a breakdown of hazards by type, such as hormone disruptors, irritants and carcinogens. Monthly, quarterly, yearly and lifetime plans are available.

Toxly is made by Mindful Code Studio, an independent developer.

name: IBS Coach Complete FODMAP Diet
description:
The Gold Standard FODMAP Diet Plan

Based on 15+ years of scientific research, studies show the low FODMAP diet is effective at reducing IBS symptoms in up to 75% of people.

The low FODMAP diet helps manage digestive symptoms, including: Bloating, Abdominal pain, Diarrhoea, Constipation, Cramps, Excessive Gas, and other digestive complaints.

The Shortest Path to Getting Results

People typically feel relief within 10-14 days of starting a low FODMAP plan. IBS Coach is the complete FODMAP diet app for beginners - guiding you through a step-by-step plan, without the stress of figuring it out on your own.

Low FODMAP isn't a forever diet. It's a temporary, structured plan to calm your digestion, identify your unique triggers, and get back to normal living.

Have you been told to try a low FODMAP diet?

You might have been given a FODMAP food list and left to get on with it. Attempting the FODMAP diet with a simple food list when you need a guided plan is the reason people fail the elimination phase or get stuck eating low FODMAP forever.

The Plan in Three Steps

IBS Coach has been developed with dietitians and doctors to make the process simple, enjoyable, and delicious:

1. Calm your gut: Get your digestion under control with our guided low FODMAP elimination phase.
2. Test your triggers: Safely test your tolerance to specific foods to identify your trigger ingredients. Everyone is different. Don't skip this step.
3. Get back to normal living: Knowing your triggers means you're in control and can enjoy meals again.

What's Included: Your Complete FODMAP Plan

Built with dietitians and doctors, your gold standard FODMAP plan includes:

- Meal Planner & Automated Shopping Lists: Personalised weekly plans with shopping lists built for you.
- 100+ Dietitian-Approved Low FODMAP Recipes: Breakfasts, lunches, dinners, desserts and snacks — with Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Lactose-Free, Vegan & Vegetarian options.
- A–Z FODMAP Ingredient Database: Look up any ingredient and know instantly if it's safe, caution or avoid.
- The SOS Flare-Up Guide: Know exactly what to do when symptoms strike.
- Comprehensive Symptom Tracker: Log symptoms, add your own notes, and spot the patterns behind your triggers.
- Progress Reports: Track and monitor your improvement over time.
- Knowledge Bank: Bite-sized education to understand your gut and stay in control.

Daily Science-Backed Education & Practical Tips

As well as the complete FODMAP plan, IBS Coach helps you understand and improve your digestion:

- Diet education: learn about FODMAPs and how ingredients trigger symptoms
- Stress management: science-backed techniques to calm non-dietary triggers
- Exercise for digestive health: practical movement tips to support digestion
- A good sleep plan for digestion: improve sleep, a key factor that may contribute to flare-ups

Everyone is different, and your personalised plan helps you take control of your IBS. Join over 100,000 people discovering meals that work for their gut. Get back to living your life again.

Please note: IBS Coach does not diagnose, treat or cure any disease and does not replace a medical doctor. You should seek a doctor's advice before starting any new diet or wellness plan.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

Then the work begins.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Maybe you feel better.

Maybe you don't.

Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.

That's the part I wanted to fix.

EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.

All restaurants start with someone in the gluten-free community who had a safe experience and told us about it.

Then our team gets to work.

First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.

Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?

Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.

Community starting points.

Independent research.

Complete transparency.

WHY I BUILT GLUTEN DUDE.

I've had celiac disease since 2007.

Like you, I've spent way too much time trying to figure out where it was actually safe to eat. I've been glutened by restaurants that sounded confident. I've asked all the awkward questions.

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

Why isn't someone doing this for us?

So I built the app I wished I'd had.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT.

Every restaurant is clearly labeled, so there's never any guessing about what you're getting.

• 100% Gluten-Free
Dedicated gluten-free restaurants.

• Dude Vetted
Personally researched by our team, complete with detailed notes about cross-contact procedures, kitchen practices, dedicated fryers, and staff knowledge.

• User Suggested
Restaurants we've researched but couldn't fully verify directly, backed by positive experiences from our community.

• Trusted Chains
Chain restaurants our community consistently trusts.

No mystery ratings.

No hidden scoring.

Just complete transparency.

BUILT FOR LIFE WITH CELIAC.

Gluten Dude is more than a gluten-free restaurant finder.

It's a travel companion.

• Trip Planner
Find trusted restaurants along your exact driving route.

• Airport Dining
Browse gluten-free options in more than 100 airports, organized by terminal.

• Destination Planning
Know your safest dining options before you leave home.

Because the best trips are the ones where you spend your time making memories, not searching for your next meal.

NO PAY-TO-PLAY.

Restaurants can't pay to be featured. No ads influencing what you see.

Every restaurant is here because it earned its place.

Because trust is everything.

SAVE MONEY.

Living gluten-free is expensive enough.

Gluten Dude members get exclusive discounts on hundreds of gluten-free products to help make it a little easier.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS.

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Nothing else I've seen has the breadth of up-to-date, peace-of-mind info on where to safely go." - GF Seeker

"I feel much more confident using your app vs. any other. How diligent you are is what separates you from the rest." - Laura

"I won't use any other app besides yours - because safety first!" - Kelly

"Love the app when I was planning a road trip! So nice being able to see different routes with GF options!" - Kristen

FROM SOMEONE WHO GETS IT...

I know what it's like to stand outside a restaurant wondering if you're making the right decision.

I know what it's like to be tired of second-guessing every meal.

That's why Gluten Dude exists.

Not to tell you where to eat.

To help you feel confident about where you choose to eat.

Travelling abroad? Show the staff a clear message about coeliac disease in their own language. The travel card covers 18 languages - from French, Italian and Spanish to Greek, Polish, Turkish, Chinese, Thai and Japanese - grouped by situation: the short main message, questions about the menu, questions about a specific dish, and questions about cross-contamination in the kitchen. Made for use in both shops and restaurants.

MORE THAN GLUTEN
Besides gluten, 14 other allergens are flagged, including milk, nuts, peanuts, soy and egg. The app also checks maltodextrin separately: is it made from wheat, or from a gluten-free source such as maize or potato?

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose which allergens are highlighted in the result. If you are sensitive to oats, switch on an extra warning so gluten-free oats show as red instead of yellow. Switch between a light and dark look, or let the app follow your phone.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
Every scan is saved to your history and can be looked up again instantly - even standing in a shop with no signal. Star the products you buy often to keep them at the top.

YOUR PRIVACY
No user accounts. No ads. No tracking. Your scan history stays on your own phone and is never sent to us. Ingredient lists in other languages are translated locally on your device.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Available in Danish, English, German, Spanish, Swedish and Norwegian, and picks the language from your phone automatically.

HELP OTHERS
If a product is missing, you can submit it with three photos. It is reviewed manually and added for the benefit of everyone else.

IMPORTANT
GlutenScanner is a helper tool, not medical advice. Assessments are based on product databases and automated lookups that may be incomplete or outdated. Always read the ingredient list on the packaging yourself - especially with coeliac disease or severe gluten intolerance.

Some product data comes from Open Food Facts and is used under the Open Database License (ODbL).

GlutenDodger applies Australia/New Zealand food labelling law (FSANZ Standard 1.2.7) and UK retained EU Reg 828/2014 to every verdict. The rules that apply to the packet in your hand.

Track dairy, soy, nuts or egg and every scan flags them — "Also spotted: Soy (soy lecithin)" — right on the verdict.

💄 EVEN COSMETICS
Gluten hides in Latin on cosmetics — Triticum Vulgare is wheat. GlutenDodger reads INCI names and checks cosmetic barcodes against Open Beauty Facts too.

📋 YOUR SAFE LIST, OFFLINE
Save any SAFE or CERTIFIED product to your personal Safe List. Works with no internet. No barcode match? Save it as your own named entry, photo and all.

🍽️ EAT OUT WITH CONFIDENCE
Curated GF dining picks with GF safety tags, plus one-tap links to Find Me Gluten Free and Coeliac Australia accredited venues.

🛒 FINDS — CURATED GF DISCOVERIES
New GF products, favourites and deals, updated continuously — no app update needed. Some links may earn us a commission; it never changes what we list, or any verdict.

📖 NEWLY DIAGNOSED? START HERE
The 14-day guide walks you through the first two weeks — one step a day, hosted by Dodge.

FIVE CLEAR VERDICTS
✅ CERTIFIED — recognised GF certification mark
✅ SAFE — no gluten sources found on the label
⚠️ CHECK — precautionary advisory or label unclear
🔴 AVOID — contains a gluten source
❓ UNKNOWN — not enough data; we show you what to do next
Every verdict shows its source and date — and every SAFE verdict reminds you: the label is the authority.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
No account. No name. No email. No ads. No analytics. Camera images never leave your device. 'Delete all my data' wipes everything instantly.

Product data: Open Food Facts + Open Beauty Facts (openfoodfacts.org, ODbL). Label scan: on-device only.

REGIONS
Australia · New Zealand · United Kingdom · More coming

WHO IT'S FOR
Coeliacs who need certainty. People with non-coeliac gluten sensitivity. Parents managing a GF household. Carers. Anyone diagnosed in the last six months.

DISCLAIMER
GlutenDodger is an information aid, not medical advice. Always check the physical label for new products, and consult your dietitian for personalised guidance.

name: Food Diary - Stop Binge Eating
description:

Food Diary is a free intuitive eating companion designed to help you stop binge eating, understand your habits, and eat without guilt. No calories. No macros. No diet rules. Just a calm, honest food journal that helps you see why you eat the way you do.

What is Food Diary?

Food Diary is a free food journal built around intuitive eating principles. Unlike calorie counters and macro trackers, Food Diary focuses on awareness, not restriction. It's for anyone who feels out of control around food and wants to stop binge eating for good, not just until Monday.

Stop binge eating with your personal food journal!

Most people who struggle with binge eating aren't lacking willpower. They're stuck in a cycle of restrict, binge, guilt, and repeat. Food Diary helps you understand that cycle, break it, and build eating habits that actually last.

Log meals without judgment in your free food diary. See how your mood, hunger, and habits connect over time. Understand the emotional triggers behind binge eating. Build a kinder, more intuitive eating mindset, one meal at a time.

Why Food Diary is the best free food journal for intuitive eating!

Free food diary with no calorie counting or macro tracking. Daily, weekly, and monthly insights from your food journal. Record meals, hunger levels, and emotions in one place. Intuitive eating tips and bite-sized lessons in every update. Personalised patterns that help you stop binge eating over time. A food journal that supports you, not judges you.

Intuitive eating, not another diet.

Food Diary is grounded in intuitive eating and habit psychology. It won't tell you what to eat. It helps you understand yourself, so the restrict-binge-guilt cycle loses its grip. This is a free food journal for people who are done with dieting and ready to try something that actually works.

Who is Food Diary for?

Anyone who wants to stop binge eating without starting another diet. People exploring intuitive eating for the first time. Anyone who feels guilty about food most days and wants that to change. People who've tried every food journal, calorie app, and clean eating plan and are ready for a different approach.

Free to download. Better by design.

Food Diary is free to download and free to start. Premium unlocks weekly insights, personalised food journal analysis, and bite-sized lessons on why.

name: Value Diary: Food Values Diet
description:
Lose weight your way. Count simple food values with a plan that suits you, log your food in seconds, see what you have left for the day, and watch your weight come down.

Used to counting? If you know free foods, a daily goal and a weekly allowance for treats, Value Diary will feel familiar from day one. Pick your plan and keep it all in one clean, easy diary.

Free to download, with the free Classic plan.

PICK THE PLAN THAT FITS YOU
Every food has one value and you have a daily goal, with a weekly allowance for treats. Choose how much you want to count:
• Little Counting - over 300 free foods: lean meats, legumes, vegetables and whole grains. The least counting of all. (You may know it as Purple.)
• Carry Over - over 200 free foods, with a daily goal to match. (Blue)
• Clever - over 100 free foods and the biggest daily goal. (Green)
• Classic - the original, with over 50 free foods, in UK, USA/Canada and Australia versions. Free to use.
On Little Counting, Carry Over and Clever, what you don't use today carries into your week, and all three work in kilojoules too. Switch plans any time and everything you've logged stays in your diary.

LOG FOOD FAST
• Search your own foods and the built-in food guide, and tick several to add them in one go
• Scan a barcode to find a food instantly
• Search over 3 million branded foods online (Premium)
• Dining Out guide: 460+ restaurants to search (Premium)
• Meal Maker: save meals and recipes to log in one go (Premium)
• Favourites for the foods and exercise you log most

WORK OUT ANY VALUE
• Food: type in the figures from the label
• Exercise: how long and how hard, using your weight
• Alcohol: start from a typical beer, wine, spirit or cider
• Goal: your daily goal from your own details

WATER AND A DAILY CHECK-IN
• Track water against your own goal, a glass at a time
• Note how you feel: energy, hunger and sleep
• Tick off your healthy choices and add a note for the day
• Home screen widgets for water, what's left today and your weight

ACTIVITY
• Log your steps and workouts by hand, free
• Or sync them automatically from Health Connect (Premium). Fitbit and Pixel Watch work too, through Health Connect
• Your last 7 days, streaks and step records (Premium)
• Exercise earns extra values for your day

GLP-1 SUPPORT (Premium)
Taking a GLP-1 medication? Keep it all in the same diary as your food and weight.
• Log each dose and where you injected
• See your estimated levels through the week
• Record side effects and how you feel
• Set a dose reminder
Value Diary is a tracker and does not give medical advice.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Weight tracking with milestones, your pace and BMI
• See when you'll reach your goal at your current pace
• Body fat
• Body measurements: waist, hips and more (Premium)
• Blood sugar and blood pressure against your own targets (Premium)

EVERY DAY
• Your day at a glance: what's left, meal by meal, and your weekly allowance
• Reminders for weigh day, GLP-1 doses and food logging, only when you haven't logged yet (Premium)
• Plan ahead: log food and exercise for the days to come (Premium)
• Secure backup, and move your diary to a new phone (Premium)
• Export your diary to a spreadsheet (Premium)
• Lock your diary with your fingerprint, face or screen lock

PREMIUM
Premium is an optional subscription, for six or twelve months, that unlocks every plan and everything marked Premium above, removes the adverts and includes email support from the developers.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is taken from your Google Play account when you confirm. It renews automatically unless cancelled, and you can manage or cancel it at any time in Google Play > Payments & subscriptions.

Value Diary is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by any weight loss programme.

Help: valuediarysupport@fenlandersoftware.com
Privacy Policy: https://android.ultimatevaluediary.com/privacy-policy/
